The castle served the princes of Lüneburg as a temporary residence and became an administrative seat during the War of the Lüneburg Succession after 1371. A fire devastated much of the town in 1585. In 1593 Duchess Dorothea, widow of William the Younger and daughter of King Christian III of Denmark, took up residence at the castle and had it rebuilt. Witch trials took place here around 1610; after her death in 1617 the castle again housed local administration.
simp_chinese: 温森位于易北河以南的卢厄河畔，旁有一座水城堡，最早见于1299年的记载。城堡曾是吕讷堡亲王的临时居所，1371年吕讷堡继承战争爆发后成为行政驻地。1585年的大火烧毁城镇大片地区。1593年，小威廉公爵的遗孀、丹麦国王克里斯蒂安三世之女多萝西娅迁入城堡，并将其重建。约1610年，城堡内举行了巫术审判；1617年公爵夫人去世后，城堡再次成为地方行政驻地。

english: Winsen on the Aller stands north of the river at a ford where trading roads crossed. A toll station served travellers, while the parish church and a local court made the settlement a centre for neighbouring villages. Its priest Conrad appears in a charter of 1315. In 1388 the decisive battle of the Lüneburg War of Succession was fought near Winsen, ending the long conflict in favour of the Welfs. Farming, small crafts, trade, timber rafting and navigation on the Aller all contributed to local livelihoods.
simp_chinese: 阿勒河畔温森位于河流北岸，一处渡口和多条商路在附近交汇。税站服务往来旅人，教区教堂与地方法庭使聚落成为邻近村庄的中心。1315年的一份宪章中记载了当地司铎康拉德。1388年，吕讷堡继承战争的决定性战役在温森附近打响，长期冲突以韦尔夫家族获胜而结束。农业、小手工业、贸易，以及阿勒河上的木筏运输和航运，都为当地居民提供生计。

english: The Groot Winterhoek mountains rise north of the Tulbagh valley in the southwestern Cape. Their rugged sandstone heights support mountain fynbos and give rise to streams that flow towards the surrounding valleys. In hollows and shelters among the rocks are paintings left by San and Khoekhoe inhabitants. These mountains form part of the folded ranges that stand between the Cape's coastal plains and the inland country of the Bokkeveld.
simp_chinese: 大温特胡克山脉耸立在开普西南部蒂尔巴赫谷地以北。崎岖的砂岩高地生长着山地芬博斯灌丛，溪流从这里发源，流向周围河谷。岩石间的凹穴和遮蔽处保存着桑人及科伊科伊人留下的画作。这些山脉属于开普褶皱山系，横亘在沿海平原与内陆博克维尔德之间。

english:
The Wintu lived in the northern Sacramento Valley and the mountains to its west, with communities also along the upper Trinity and lower McCloud Rivers. Acorns were ground into flour for soups and bread, and families gathered at the rivers for the spring and autumn salmon runs. Along Clear Creek, villages occupied the lower country in winter while people moved into the mountains in summer to hunt and gather.

Jedediah Smith's expedition encountered the Wintu in 1826, followed by Peter Skene Ogden's party the next year. Between 1830 and 1833, an epidemic of malaria killed many Wintu and other Indigenous people in the upper Sacramento Valley. The disease reached communities whose lives had long followed the seasonal rhythms of the rivers and mountains.
simp_chinese:
温图人居住在萨克拉门托谷地北部及其以西的山地，三一河上游和麦克劳德河下游也有他们的社群。人们将橡实磨粉，制成汤和面饼；春秋鲑鱼洄游时，家庭聚集到河边捕鱼。在克利尔溪沿岸，村民冬季住在低地，夏季进入山中狩猎和采集。

1826年，杰迪戴亚·史密斯的探险队遇到温图人；次年，彼得·斯基恩·奥格登的队伍也来到这里。1830年至1833年间，疟疾流行使萨克拉门托谷地的许多温图人和其他原住民丧生。疾病袭击的这些社群，世代以来依照河流与山地的季节变化生活。

english:
The Winyah lived around the bay that bears their name and along the lower Pee Dee and Black rivers. Their river country opened onto the Carolina coast through an estuary fed by several waterways. Although the Winyah were at times allies of English settlers, that relationship did not shield them from the colonial trade in enslaved Indigenous people.

In 1683 traders encouraged conflict as a pretext for taking captives; even Winyah envoys seeking peace were enslaved. During the Yamasee War in 1715 the Winyah remained allied to the English despite pressure from the Cheraw to join their enemies. Some later lived near other displaced communities and a colonial trading post. They petitioned for land in 1724, and a map still placed them between the Black and Pee Dee rivers in 1752.
simp_chinese:
温亚人居住在以他们命名的海湾周围，以及皮迪河和布莱克河下游。数条水道在河口汇合，使这片河流地区通向卡罗来纳海岸。温亚人有时与英国移民结盟，但这种关系并未使他们免受殖民地原住民奴隶贸易的侵害。

1683年，商人鼓动冲突，借机掳取俘虏，连寻求和平的温亚使者也遭到奴役。1715年亚马西战争期间，尽管彻劳人施压要求他们加入反英阵营，温亚人仍与英国人结盟。后来，一些人居住在其他流离社群和殖民贸易站附近。他们于1724年请求土地；1752年的地图仍将温亚人标在布莱克河与皮迪河之间。

english: Wipetikil lies on Newfoundland's Great Northern Peninsula, near the rivers that enter Canada Bay. French and English ships visited these northern shores for fish from the early sixteenth century. Under the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713, France retained seasonal fishing rights along the coast; after 1783 the French Treaty Shore extended between Cape St. John and Cape Ray.
simp_chinese: 维佩蒂基尔位于纽芬兰大北方半岛，靠近流入加拿大湾的河流。十六世纪初起，法国和英国船只便来到这些北部海岸捕鱼。根据1713年的《乌得勒支条约》，法国保留了沿岸季节性捕鱼权；1783年以后，法国条约海岸的范围为圣约翰角至雷角。

english:
Wipi belongs to the southern coastal lowlands of New Guinea, where rivers and wetlands spread towards the shores of the Gulf of Papua. Wipi is a Papuan language of this region, distinct from the many other languages spoken in the neighbouring river country. The coast lies close to the great Fly River delta, whose channels connect inland communities with the sea.

The later city of Daru lies here.
simp_chinese:
维皮位于新几内亚南部沿海低地，河流与湿地向巴布亚湾海岸延伸。维皮语是这一地区的一种巴布亚语言，不同于邻近河流地区使用的许多其他语言。海岸接近广阔的弗莱河三角洲，其水道将内陆社群与大海相连。

后来的达鲁即位于此地。

english: The Wi:pukba were the northeastern Yavapai, whose homeland included the upper Verde River, Oak Creek Canyon and Fossil Creek. Their name has been rendered as the people at the foot of the red rocks, a fitting description of the country around the canyon. The Wi:pukba shared parts of this region with Northern Tonto Apache communities. Though Yavapai and Apache spoke different languages, their families intermarried and some people spoke both tongues. The Verde Valley was home to both peoples for many generations.
simp_chinese: 维普克巴人是东北亚瓦派人，家园包括佛得河上游、橡树溪峡谷和福西尔溪。他们的名字可译为“红岩脚下的人”，让人想起峡谷周围的景色。维普克巴人与北通托阿帕奇社群共同生活于这片地区的一部分。亚瓦派语和阿帕奇语虽不相同，两族家庭却相互通婚，一些人兼通两种语言。两族世代居住在佛得河谷。

english: Wiradjuri country extends across a large inland region of southeastern Australia, encompassing the Lachlan, Macquarie and Murrumbidgee river systems. River valleys, plains and wooded hills supported numerous local communities joined by language and kinship. British expansion inland in the early nineteenth century brought settlers into Wiradjuri lands and provoked violent resistance, including conflict around Bathurst in the 1820s.
simp_chinese: 维拉朱里地区横跨澳大利亚东南部广阔内陆，包括拉克兰河、麦夸里河和马兰比吉河水系。河谷、平原与林木山丘养育了众多地方社群，他们以语言和亲属关系相连。十九世纪初英国人向内陆扩张，殖民者进入维拉朱里土地，引发激烈抵抗，其中包括1820年代巴瑟斯特一带的冲突。

english: Wirameju is a name recorded for the Ngadjuri people of the inland country north of the Adelaide Plains. It refers to the gum forests associated with their lands. Ngadjuri country stretches through hills and valleys towards the southern Flinders Ranges, with Nukunu country to the west and Kaurna country to the south.
simp_chinese: 维拉梅朱是阿德莱德平原以北内陆恩加朱里人的记录名称，指与其土地相关的桉树林。恩加朱里地区穿过丘陵和河谷，向南弗林德斯山脉延伸；西面是努库努地区，南面是考纳地区。

english: Wirangu country extends along the western coast of the Eyre Peninsula in southern Australia, including the bays and inland country around Ceduna. Wirangu is a distinct Aboriginal language, related to those of neighbouring Nawu and Barngarla communities. The coast, scrub and water places inland formed a connected landscape, with seasonal movement and relationships extending across the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 维兰古地区沿澳大利亚南部艾尔半岛西岸延伸，包括塞杜纳一带的海湾与内陆。维兰古语是一种独立的原住民语言，与邻近纳乌和巴恩加拉社群的语言有关。海岸、灌丛与内陆水源地构成相连的土地，季节性迁徙和社会关系跨越半岛。

english: Wirrai Durhai is a recorded form of the name Wiradjuri, associated with the inland river country of southeastern Australia. Wiradjuri lands encompass the Lachlan, Macquarie and Murrumbidgee river systems. Communities along these rivers shared language and relationships across a landscape of plains, woodland and floodplains.
simp_chinese: 维莱杜尔海是维拉朱里名称的一种记录形式，与澳大利亚东南部内陆河流地区有关。维拉朱里土地包括拉克兰河、麦夸里河和马兰比吉河水系。沿河社群在平原、林地与泛滥平原之间共享语言并维系社会关系。

english: Wishkahuunu is a form of a name recorded for the North Platte River, which crosses western Nebraska on its way east to join the South Platte. The broad valley is bordered by grasslands and bluffs, and its sandy channels carry water from the mountains across the high plains. The river offered a route through the country of Plains peoples, linking their hunting grounds with the waterways farther east.
simp_chinese: 维什卡胡努是北普拉特河一个记载名称的形式。这条河穿过内布拉斯加西部，向东与南普拉特河汇合。宽阔河谷两侧是草地和崖地，沙质河道将山地水流带过高平原。河流穿越平原民族的活动地区，将猎场与更东边的水道联系起来。

english:
The Wishram lived on the north bank of the Columbia near the great rapids and falls at The Dalles. Their villages stood at the meeting of Chinookan and Sahaptin country, where salmon fishing and overland portages made the river a great place of trade. Fishers worked from wooden scaffolds with long-handled dip nets, and dried salmon travelled to communities far from the river.

Lewis and Clark camped beside the Wishram village of Nixluidix in 1805 and returned the following spring. In April 1806 they witnessed a ceremony honouring the first salmon of the season, as people gathered once more at the fisheries that drew visitors from across the plateau. The expedition had to carry its goods around the dangerous rapids, following a portage long used by local travellers.
simp_chinese:
维什拉姆人生活在哥伦比亚河北岸，靠近达尔斯一带的大急流和瀑布。他们的村落位于奇努克语与萨哈普廷语地区的交界处；鲑鱼捕捞和绕过急流的陆路搬运，使这里成为重要的贸易场所。渔人站在木架上，用长柄抄网捕鱼，晒干的鲑鱼被运往远离大河的社群。

1805年，刘易斯与克拉克在维什拉姆人的尼克斯卢伊迪克斯村旁扎营，次年春天又返回此地。1806年4月，他们见证了纪念当年第一条鲑鱼的仪式；人们再次聚集在渔场，来自高原各地的访客也在这里相会。远征队须沿当地旅人长期使用的搬运路，绕过危险的急流搬运物资。

english: Wiskapella is an early name for the Solomon River of Kansas, a watercourse whose north and south forks drain the central Plains. The branches meet and flow eastward to the Smoky Hill River. The name was recorded with the meaning “salt water,” recalling the character of streams in this prairie country. Their valleys link the open grasslands of the west with the more wooded river country farther east.
simp_chinese: 维斯凯佩拉是堪萨斯所罗门河的早期名称。这条河的南北支流汇集中央平原的水流，汇合后向东注入斯莫基希尔河。记载中的河名意为“盐水”，反映了这片草原地区部分水道的特征。河谷将西部开阔草地与东部林木较多的河流地带联系起来。

english:
Wiślica is an ancient settlement on the Nida, near the road from Kraków to Sandomierz. In the twelfth century it was briefly the seat of a duchy, with princely residences and churches. A remarkable engraved gypsum floor, the Slab of the Orants, survives from a Romanesque church's burial crypt. Władysław the Elbow-high granted the town a charter in 1326.

Casimir the Great built walls, a castle and a Gothic collegiate church at Wiślica. The town became a meeting place for political assemblies and was associated with the proclamation of his legal statutes. Its privileges included bridge tolls and the right to store salt; its beer reached the royal court at Kraków. Around 1460 the chronicler Jan Długosz founded a bell tower and a residence for the canons and clergy serving the church.
simp_chinese:
维希利察是尼达河畔的一处古老聚落，靠近克拉科夫通往桑多梅日的道路。十二世纪，这里曾短暂成为公国治所，建有公爵居所和教堂。一座罗曼式教堂的墓室中留存着精美的石膏刻画地板，被称为“祈祷者石板”。瓦迪斯瓦夫一世于1326年授予城镇特许。

卡齐米日大帝在维希利察修建城墙、城堡和哥特式共议教堂。城镇成为政治集会的地点，也与他的法律章程的公布相联系。它享有征收桥梁通行费和储存食盐等特权，当地啤酒被送往克拉科夫的王室宫廷。约1460年，编年史家扬·德乌戈什为教堂兴建钟楼及供教士居住的房屋。

english:
Wismar's sheltered harbour opens onto a Baltic bay behind the island of Poel. The town was established in the thirteenth century in lands formerly inhabited by the Obotrites. In 1259 it joined Lübeck and Rostock in an agreement against pirates, part of the growing cooperation that gave rise to the Hanseatic League. Trade and wool processing brought prosperity, despite a plague that killed many inhabitants in 1376.

The Peace of Westphalia awarded Wismar to Sweden in 1648. Its rulers strengthened the defences, and from 1653 the Fürstenhof housed the supreme court for Sweden's possessions within the Empire. Danish forces besieged and captured the town in 1675 during the Scanian War. In 1803 Sweden transferred Wismar to Mecklenburg-Schwerin against payment, reserving a right to redeem it a century later.
simp_chinese:
维斯马的天然良港面向波罗的海海湾，波尔岛为其提供屏障。十三世纪，城市建立在昔日阿波德里特人的土地上。1259年，它与吕贝克、罗斯托克订立共同对付海盗的协议，这种日益紧密的合作后来孕育了汉萨同盟。贸易和羊毛加工带来繁荣，尽管1376年的瘟疫夺走许多居民的生命。

1648年威斯特伐利亚和约将维斯马授予瑞典。瑞典统治者加强了城防，1653年起，亲王宫成为瑞典在帝国境内领地的最高法院所在地。1675年斯堪尼亚战争期间，丹麦军围攻并攻占城市。1803年，瑞典收取款项后将维斯马转交梅克伦堡—什未林，但保留一百年后赎回的权利。

english:
Gichi Onigamiing, the Great Carrying Place, joins Lake Superior to the Pigeon River. Indigenous travellers carried canoes and goods along the trail to avoid the falls and rapids of the river’s lower course. The bay at the eastern end was also the site of an Ojibwe summer village, linked to winter hunting grounds and spring maple sugar camps inland.

After La Vérendrye arrived in 1731, French traders increasingly used the route to reach the interior. The place became known to them as Grand Portage and grew into a major meeting point of the fur trade. By the 1780s the North West Company maintained a depot at the lake and another post at the inland end. Each summer traders and Indigenous hunters gathered to exchange furs and goods; the company moved its main depot away in 1803.
simp_chinese:
吉奇奥尼加明意为“大搬运地”，是一条连接苏必利尔湖与皮金河的陆路。原住民旅人沿此路搬运独木舟和货物，绕过河流下游的瀑布与急流。东端海湾也是奥吉布瓦人的夏季村庄所在地，与内陆的冬季狩猎地和春季枫糖营地相连。

1731年拉韦朗德里到达后，法国商人越来越多地利用此路进入内陆。他们称此地为大搬运地，那里逐渐成为毛皮贸易的重要会合处。十八世纪八十年代，西北公司在湖畔设有货栈，在内陆一端设有另一处商站。每年夏天，商人与原住民猎手聚集交换毛皮和货物；1803年，公司迁走了主要货栈。

english: Wit’anowi’yohe is a recorded name for the Tongue River, which rises in the Bighorn Mountains and flows northward across the plains to join the Yellowstone. Its valley runs through the country between the Powder and Bighorn rivers. Cottonwoods grow along the water amid the drier surrounding land, and the river collects tributaries descending from the mountains and neighboring uplands before reaching the Yellowstone.
simp_chinese: 维坦诺维约赫是通河的一个记载名称。通河发源于比格霍恩山脉，向北穿过平原，汇入黄石河。河谷位于保德河与比格霍恩河之间；周围土地较为干燥，河边则生长着杨树。河流汇集从山地及邻近高地流下的支流，然后到达黄石河。

english: Witagron, formerly known as Bitagron, is a Kwinti Maroon village on the Coppename River in Suriname. The Kwinti descend from people who escaped enslavement and formed communities in the forested interior. The Coppename flows northwards through the Guiana forests to the Atlantic coastal plain, linking inland settlements with the lower river. Its rapids and forested banks form part of the landscape in which Maroon communities established independent lives.
simp_chinese: 维塔格龙旧称比塔格龙，是苏里南科珀纳默河畔的昆蒂马龙人村庄。昆蒂人是逃离奴役、在森林内陆建立社群的人们的后代。科珀纳默河向北穿过圭亚那森林，流向大西洋沿岸平原，将内陆聚落与河流下游联系起来。急流和林木覆盖的河岸，构成马龙社群建立独立生活的环境。

english: Witset stands beside a canyon of the Bulkley River, an important fishing place in Wet’suwet’en country. Salmon returning upstream pass through the narrow waters, drawing families to the river in summer. Wet’suwet’en people gathered at fishing villages and feasts along the Bulkley, while winter brought movement into their dispersed house territories to hunt and fish. Their oral history remembers the ancestral village of Dizkle upstream from the canyon.
simp_chinese: 维策特位于巴尔克利河峡谷旁，是韦楚韦滕地区重要的渔场。洄游的鲑鱼经过狭窄水道，夏季吸引各家庭来到河边。韦楚韦滕人在巴尔克利河畔的渔村和宴会上聚集，冬季则进入分散的家系领地狩猎捕鱼。他们的口述历史记述了峡谷上游的祖先村落迪兹克勒。

english:
Wittenberg stands on the Elbe along the north-south trade road of the Via Imperii, where the Ascanian dukes of Saxony made their residence in the thirteenth century. Duke Albert II granted it town rights in 1293, and its council is first recorded in 1317. By 1337 the town had a Franciscan friary founded by Duchess Helena, walls built under its charter, and a ducal court that turned a modest market of bakers, butchers, shoemakers and clothmakers into the capital of Saxe-Wittenberg.

The Ascanians' rise came in 1356, when Rudolf I saw his duchy confirmed as an electorate of the Empire, giving Wittenberg the status of an electoral capital. The line died out with Albert III in 1422, and the electoral title passed to the Wettin margraves of Meissen; the town lost its court but kept its privileges, gaining the right of high justice in 1444. Its walls held in 1429, when Hussite armies besieged the town but could not take it.

Wittenberg's greatest age came when Elector Frederick the Wise settled here from 1486. A second bridge crossed the Elbe by 1490, the Castle Church was raised between 1496 and 1506, and in 1502 the elector founded a university. Martin Luther taught theology there from 1508, and Philipp Melanchthon arrived as professor of Greek in 1518. On 31 October 1517 Luther is said to have posted his Ninety-five Theses on the door of the Castle Church, and the town became the cradle of the Reformation. After the Schmalkaldic War, the Capitulation of 1547 stripped John Frederick the Magnanimous of the electoral dignity and gave it to the Albertine Wettins. The Austrians shelled the town in 1760, and in 1813 Napoleon had it refortified.
simp_chinese:
维滕贝格坐落在易北河畔，位于南北向的帝国大道上，13世纪时，萨克森的阿斯卡尼亚公爵在此建立驻地。1293年公爵阿尔布雷希特二世授予它城市权，1317年出现了有文献记载的市议会。到1337年，这里已有海伦娜公爵夫人创立的方济各会修道院，有依据城市权修筑的城墙，还有公爵宫廷，使一座由面包师、屠户、鞋匠和织呢匠构成的小集市成了萨克森-维滕贝格的首府。

阿斯卡尼亚家族的巅峰在1356年：鲁道夫一世的公国被确认为帝国选帝侯国，维滕贝格由此成为选帝侯的都城。1422年阿尔布雷希特三世去世后这一支绝嗣，选帝侯之位转到迈森边疆伯爵韦廷家族手中；城市失去宫廷，但保住了特权，1444年又获得高等审判权。1429年，胡斯军队围攻维滕贝格，未能攻克城墙。

维滕贝格最辉煌的时代始于1486年，智者腓特烈选帝侯定居于此。1490年前已有第二座易北河桥，1496至1506年间建起城堡教堂，1502年选帝侯创办大学。马丁·路德自1508年起在此讲授神学，菲利普·梅兰希通于1518年出任希腊语教授。据传1517年10月31日，路德把《九十五条论纲》钉在城堡教堂的大门上，维滕贝格成为宗教改革的摇篮。施马尔卡尔登战争后，1547年的《维滕贝格投降协议》迫使宽宏者约翰·腓特烈交出选帝侯之位，转给韦廷家族的阿尔布雷希特系。1760年奥地利军队炮击该城，1813年拿破仑下令重修其防御工事。

english: Wittenberge stands on the northern bank of the Elbe in Prignitz, near the mouths of the Stepenitz and Karthane. Its town rights were confirmed by Otto Gans in 1300. The settlement suffered severely in the Thirty Years' War, and later disasters included fires in 1686 and 1757 and breaches of the Elbe dykes in 1709 and 1761. River transport remained central to its fortunes. In 1820 a steamship on the Berlin–Hamburg passenger route called at Wittenberge, and in 1823 the merchant Salomon Herz established an oil mill. Completion of the Elbe harbour in 1835 helped lay the foundations for the town's later development.
simp_chinese: 维滕贝尔格位于普里格尼茨地区的易北河北岸，靠近施特佩尼茨河和卡尔塔讷河的入河处。1300年，领主奥托·甘斯确认了当地城市权利。三十年战争给城镇带来严重破坏，此后又遭受1686年和1757年的火灾，以及1709年和1761年的易北河堤决口。河运仍是当地发展的重要条件。1820年，柏林至汉堡客运航线的一艘蒸汽船在此靠泊；1823年，商人萨洛蒙·赫茨建立榨油厂。1835年易北河港口竣工，为城镇后来的发展奠定了基础。

english: Wittlich lies on the Lieser in the southern Eifel, in a side valley of the Moselle. It was recorded in 1065, and in 1300 Diether of Nassau, Archbishop-Elector of Trier, granted it town rights. The electors built Ottenstein Castle here in the Middle Ages, expressing their authority over the town and surrounding district. In the eighteenth century the castle gave way to the hunting lodge of Philippsfreude, which was destroyed during the French Revolutionary period. Wittlich's position in a cultivated basin made it a local centre between the Eifel hills and the Moselle valley, within the territories governed by Trier's ecclesiastical princes.
simp_chinese: 维特利希位于南艾费尔地区的利泽河畔，处在摩泽尔河的一条支谷中。它于1065年见于文献，1300年获得特里尔大主教兼选帝侯拿骚的迪特尔授予的城市权利。中世纪，特里尔选帝侯在此修筑奥滕施泰因城堡，体现其对城镇和周边地区的统治。十八世纪，城堡被菲利普斯弗罗伊德狩猎宫取代；狩猎宫在法国大革命时期遭到毁坏。维特利希位于可耕作的盆地，是艾费尔丘陵与摩泽尔河谷之间的地方中心，长期处于特里尔教会诸侯的领地内。

english: Wittstock stands on the Dosse in the Prignitz region of Brandenburg. Its castle served as a residence of the bishops of Havelberg from 1271 until the Reformation, and the last Catholic prince-bishop died there in 1548. During the Thirty Years' War, Swedish forces under Johan Banér and Alexander Leslie defeated an Imperial and Saxon army at the Battle of Wittstock in 1636. Plague followed in 1638, and the town suffered severe population losses. Elector Frederick William began its redevelopment in 1658; around 1750 settlers from Württemberg and the Palatinate came to the region. The brick walls and St Mary's Church preserve the town's earlier defensive and ecclesiastical history.
simp_chinese: 维特施托克位于勃兰登堡普里格尼茨地区的多瑟河畔。自1271年起，城堡是哈弗尔贝格主教的驻地，直至宗教改革时期；最后一位天主教亲王主教于1548年在此去世。三十年战争中，约翰·巴内尔和亚历山大·莱斯利指挥的瑞典军队于1636年在维特施托克战役击败帝国与萨克森联军。1638年瘟疫接踵而至，城镇人口损失惨重。选侯腓特烈·威廉于1658年着手重建，约1750年又有来自符腾堡和普法尔茨的移民来到这一地区。砖砌城墙和圣玛丽教堂保留着城镇早期防御及教会历史的痕迹。

english: The Vitim is a major tributary of the Lena, rising in the mountains east of Lake Baikal. It curves around the Vitim plateau, then cuts north through mountain ranges between the North Baikal and Patom highlands. Rapids interrupt its course, including the Param rapids in the middle reaches. After a journey of more than eighteen hundred kilometres, the river meets the Lena opposite the settlement of Vitim.
simp_chinese: 维季姆河是勒拿河的重要支流，发源于贝加尔湖以东的山地。它绕过维季姆高原，向北切穿山脉，流经北贝加尔高地与帕托姆高地之间。河道中有多处急流，包括中游的帕拉姆急流。经过一千八百多公里的旅程，它在维季姆聚落对岸汇入勒拿河。

english: Wiyashakimi is the Cree name for a great lake in the northern interior east of Hudson Bay. It means “clear water,” and the Inuit name for the lake refers to the Cree, who used its shores. Its outlet, the Clearwater River, flows west toward Tasiujaq and the bay. In 1818 George Atkinson travelled inland from Tasiujaq with Indigenous companions, reaching the lake by way of the Caribou River before continuing toward the country of the inland seals.
simp_chinese: 维亚沙基米是哈得孙湾以东内陆一座大湖的克里语名称，意为“清澈的水”。湖的因纽特语名字提到了克里人，后者曾利用湖岸的资源。清水河从湖中流出，向西流往塔西尤阿克及哈得孙湾。1818年，乔治·阿特金森与原住民同伴从塔西尤阿克出发，沿卡里布河抵达此湖，随后继续前往内陆海豹出没的地区。

english: Wizi lies in the Kongo-speaking country south of Mbanza Kongo, among the hills and river valleys of the interior. To the north stood the territories of Wembo and Wandu, both brought into the Kongo kingdom as it expanded southward. In the sixteenth century King Afonso I named his brother as ruler of Wembo and one of his sons as ruler of Wandu.
simp_chinese: 维济位于姆班扎刚果以南的刚果语地区，周围是内陆的丘陵与河谷。北面的温博和万杜均在刚果王国向南扩张时被纳入其疆域。十六世纪，国王阿丰索一世任命兄弟统治温博，又将万杜交给一位儿子治理。

english: Wizna stands by an important crossing of the Narew, where a castle guarded the eastern frontier of Mazovia from at least the eleventh century. It became the seat of a castellany and, in 1379, the centre of the Land of Wizna. A Catholic parish was founded in 1390. The route from Lithuania toward Kraków passed through the town, which remained an important royal and administrative centre until nearby Łomża grew in prominence. In 1795 the Third Partition of Poland brought Wizna under Prussian rule.
simp_chinese: 维兹纳位于纳雷夫河重要渡口旁，至少自十一世纪起，一座城堡便在此守卫马佐夫舍东部边境。这里成为城堡辖区治所，并于1379年成为维兹纳地区的中心；1390年建立天主教教区。立陶宛通往克拉科夫的道路经过城镇，维兹纳长期是重要的王室与行政中心，直到附近的沃姆扎日益兴盛。1795年第三次瓜分波兰时，维兹纳归入普鲁士。

english: Wiznay is a name for a Wichí language variety associated with the lower Pilcomayo country. Wichí communities inhabit the forest and riverine lowlands of the Gran Chaco, where the Pilcomayo descends from the Andes and spreads into wetlands. Their languages belong to the Mataguayan family. Hunting, gathering and fishing formed complementary parts of life as communities moved through territories shaped by seasonal rain and flooding.
simp_chinese: 维兹奈是与皮尔科马约河下游地区有关的一种韦奇语变体。韦奇社群居住在大查科的森林与河流低地，皮尔科马约河从安第斯山流下，在此散入湿地。他们的语言属于马塔瓜约语族。社群在受季节性降雨和洪水影响的领地内迁徙，狩猎、采集和捕鱼相互补充。

english: Wli' Qospem, or Grand Lake, lies in the interior of western Newfoundland. Fed by numerous streams, its waters flow towards Deer Lake and the Humber River, which reaches the sea at the Bay of Islands. Mi'kmaq knowledge of the inland waterways was essential to outsiders mapping this country: James Cook's understanding of the routes between St George's Bay and Grand Lake came from Mi'kmaq informants there. The lake forms part of a broad landscape of wooded shores and water routes across the island.
simp_chinese: 维利科斯佩姆，即大湖，位于纽芬兰西部内陆。众多溪流汇入湖中，湖水流向鹿湖及亨伯河，再经群岛湾入海。米克马克人对内陆水道的知识，对外来者绘制这一地区的地图至关重要：詹姆斯·库克对圣乔治湾与大湖之间水路的认识，便来自当地米克马克人的讲述。大湖是岛上广阔森林湖岸与水道景观的一部分。

english: Włocławek stands on the Vistula in the historic lands of Kuyavia. An early Piast stronghold, it became an administrative center and a bishop's seat in the twelfth century. Ships passing along the Vistula and the Zgłowiączka paid tolls here, and a mint served the town. Its Gothic cathedral and ecclesiastical institutions reflect the long importance of the bishopric. The Teutonic Knights repeatedly attacked the town during the wars of the fourteenth century. The cathedral was rebuilt after destruction, and Włocławek continued as a center of the bishop's lands and river commerce. Its location joined the interior of Poland to the Vistula route leading toward the Baltic.
simp_chinese: 弗沃茨瓦韦克坐落在库亚维亚历史地区的维斯瓦河畔。这里原是皮雅斯特王朝的早期据点，十二世纪成为行政中心和主教驻地。经过维斯瓦河与兹格翁维翁奇卡河的船只在此缴纳通行费，镇上还有铸币厂。哥特式主教座堂及教会机构反映了主教区长久的重要地位。十四世纪战争期间，条顿骑士团多次袭击城镇。主教座堂遭破坏后得到重建，弗沃茨瓦韦克仍是主教领地与河运商业的中心。它的位置使波兰内陆与通向波罗的海的维斯瓦河航路相连。

english:
Włodawa stands on the Bug at the mouth of the Włodawka, where a crossing connected the lands of Poland and Lithuania. First mentioned in 1242, it prospered under the Sanguszko family, who acquired it in 1475 and built a castle. The town received municipal rights in 1534, and Jewish merchants and craftsmen contributed to its commerce.

Under the Calvinist Leszczyński family, Włodawa became a Protestant centre with a church and school; a synod met here in 1634. The Cossack-Tatar army devastated the town in 1648, and the Swedes struck again in 1657. Włodawa recovered as a fair town, selling horses and cattle brought from Volhynia. Its merchants sent oxen onward to cities as distant as Kraków and Vienna. In 1795 the third partition of Poland placed it under Austrian rule.
simp_chinese:
弗沃达瓦位于弗沃达夫卡河汇入布格河之处，渡口连接着波兰与立陶宛的土地。它最早见于1242年的记载，在桑古什科家族治下繁荣起来；该家族于1475年取得城镇并修建城堡。1534年弗沃达瓦获得城市权利，犹太商人与工匠对当地贸易有所贡献。

在信奉加尔文宗的莱什琴斯基家族治下，弗沃达瓦成为新教中心，建有教堂和学校；1634年一次宗教会议在此举行。1648年哥萨克与鞑靼联军摧毁城镇，1657年瑞典军又发动袭击。此后弗沃达瓦作为集市城镇复苏，出售从沃里尼亚运来的马匹和牛只，商人又将牛运往远至克拉科夫和维也纳的城市。1795年第三次瓜分波兰后，它归奥地利统治。

english: The Woccon were a people of eastern Carolina whose language was related to Catawba. Early in the eighteenth century, John Lawson recorded two Woccon villages, Yupwauremau and Tooptatmeer, near Tuscarora settlements along the lower Neuse River. He counted some 120 warriors among them. His 1709 account also preserved a vocabulary of their language, a rare record of their speech. The Woccon joined the Tuscarora against the English colonists during the war of 1711–1713, a conflict that devastated Indigenous communities in the region. Survivors were most likely absorbed into the Tuscarora, who moved north and by 1722 joined the Haudenosaunee as the sixth nation.
simp_chinese: 沃康人居住在卡罗来纳东部，语言与卡托巴语有亲缘关系。十八世纪初，约翰·劳森记载了两个沃康村庄，尤普沃雷毛和图普塔特米尔，位于纽斯河下游塔斯卡罗拉人的聚落附近。他记下当地约有一百二十名战士；他在1709年出版的著作还保存了一份词汇表，留下了这种语言的珍贵记录。1711年至1713年的战争中，沃康人与塔斯卡罗拉人共同对抗殖民者，地区原住民社群遭受沉重打击。幸存者很可能被塔斯卡罗拉人吸收，后者北迁，1722年前后作为第六个成员加入豪德诺索尼联盟。

english: Wogamusin is a Papuan language of the middle Sepik region, spoken near the junction of the Niksek or April River and the Sepik. Forested foothills, swamps and waterways surround the settlements of this area. The two rivers connect the Wogamusin country with neighbouring communities along the Sepik, a region notable for its many distinct languages.
simp_chinese: 沃加穆辛语是塞皮克河中游地区的一种巴布亚语言，分布在尼克塞克河即埃普里尔河与塞皮克河交汇处附近。森林山麓、沼泽和水道环绕这里的聚落。两条河将沃加穆辛地区与塞皮克沿岸邻居联系起来，这片区域以语言众多而著称。

english: Woi Wurrung is the language of Wurundjeri people whose country includes the Yarra River valley in southeastern Australia. Forested hills, creeks and river flats formed places of gathering and connection with neighbouring Kulin peoples. In 1835 John Batman sought an agreement with Wurundjeri elders for land around Port Phillip. The colonial authorities later rejected his claimed purchase, while settlers established themselves on the Yarra.
simp_chinese: 沃伊沃隆语是伍伦杰里人的语言，其土地包括澳大利亚东南部亚拉河谷。森林山丘、溪流和河流平地是与邻近库林人群会聚和联系的地点。1835年，约翰·巴特曼试图与伍伦杰里长老达成有关菲利普港周围土地的协议。殖民当局后来否定了他声称的购买，殖民者则在亚拉河畔定居。

english: Wokam is a large island in the northern Aru group, divided from its neighbors by channels navigable by small boats. Its forests and waterways were part of a trading world prized for birds-of-paradise, pearls, sea cucumbers and other goods. An account of Wokam's leaders describes traders from the eastern islands coming there to exchange their products, revealing the importance of local intermediaries in Aru's commerce.
simp_chinese: 沃卡姆是阿鲁群岛北部的大岛，与邻岛之间隔着小船可以通行的水道。它的森林与水域属于一片贸易世界，其极乐鸟、珍珠、海参等物产备受珍视。一则有关沃卡姆首领的记述称，来自东部岛屿的商人曾到这里交换货物，显示出地方中间人在阿鲁贸易中的重要作用。

english:
Woking lies in Surrey southwest of London, among villages, farmland, woodland and heath. The older settlement stood beside the River Wey, in a rural landscape of estates and parish communities.

A moated manor house at Woking became the home of Margaret Beaufort, mother of Henry VII. In 1503 Henry acquired the manor and transformed the house into a royal palace; a new great hall followed later in his reign. Henry VIII visited frequently and continued to alter the buildings. The palace remained a royal residence until 1620, when it was granted to Sir Edward Zouch and subsequently fell into ruin.
simp_chinese:
沃金位于伦敦西南的萨里，周围分布着村庄、农田、林地和荒地。旧聚落靠近韦河，处在由庄园和教区组成的乡村之中。

沃金一座有护城河的庄园宅邸曾是亨利七世之母玛格丽特·博福特的住所。1503年，亨利取得庄园，将宅邸改建为王宫，随后又兴建新大厅。亨利八世经常到访，并继续改造建筑。王宫作为王室住所延续至1620年，随后赐给爱德华·祖什爵士，后来逐渐荒废。

english: The Wolastoq, or “beautiful river,” rises in the northern forests and flows to the Bay of Fundy. It is the homeland of the Wolastoqiyik, whose name is drawn from the river itself. Canoe routes and portages linked its upper waters with Lake Témiscouata and the St. Lawrence, as well as with other neighbouring watersheds. French visitors reached the river mouth in 1604; later, Acadian families displaced by war travelled upstream and settled in the Madawaska region.
simp_chinese: 沃拉斯托克意为“美丽的河”，发源于北方森林，流入芬迪湾。它是沃拉斯托基人的故土，族名正取自这条河。独木舟水路与陆上搬舟道将上游同泰米斯库阿塔湖、圣劳伦斯河及其他邻近流域相连。1604年法国人抵达河口；此后，因战争流离失所的阿卡迪亚家庭沿河而上，在马达瓦斯卡地区定居。

english: Woleai is a coral atoll in the central Caroline Islands, with low islets arranged around a lagoon. Its communities maintained sailing canoes and connections with islands to the east and Yap to the west. Oral histories from several outer islands remember chiefly clans coming from Woleai or other western islands, reflecting longstanding relationships across the sea.
simp_chinese: 沃莱艾是加罗林群岛中部的一座珊瑚环礁，低矮小岛环绕潟湖。当地社群保有帆船独木舟，并与东方岛屿及西方雅浦维持联系。数座外岛的口述历史记得首领氏族来自沃莱艾或其他西方岛屿，反映了海洋两岸长期维系的关系。

english:
Wolfenbüttel developed around a moated castle on the Oker, south of Brunswick. As the citizens of Brunswick acquired greater independence, the Welf dukes increasingly preferred this residence; from 1432 their court was permanently established here. Palace, churches and carefully laid-out streets made the small town the centre of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel's government and courtly life.

Duke Julius's collection of books became the basis of the ducal library, formally established by an ordinance of 1572. Duke August greatly enlarged its holdings in the seventeenth century, making Wolfenbüttel a place of study for scholars from far beyond the principality. Its books and manuscripts reflected the ambitions of a court that valued learning as well as government. In 1753 Duke Charles I moved his residence back to Brunswick, leaving the palace at Wolfenbüttel without its court. The library remained: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing became its librarian in 1770 and lived for a time in rooms of the former palace. The town's scholarly life thus outlasted its centuries as a ducal residence.
simp_chinese:
沃尔芬比特尔围绕奥克尔河畔的一座水城堡发展，位于不伦瑞克以南。随着不伦瑞克市民获得更大独立，韦尔夫公爵越来越偏爱这处居所；自1432年起，宫廷长期驻于此地。宫殿、教堂和规划整齐的街道使小城成为不伦瑞克-沃尔芬比特尔的政务与宫廷生活中心。

尤利乌斯公爵的藏书成为公爵图书馆的基础，1572年的条例正式确立了这座图书馆。十七世纪，奥古斯特公爵大幅扩充藏书，使沃尔芬比特尔成为远方学者求学之地。书籍与手稿体现了宫廷对学问和治理同样重视的抱负。1753年，查理一世公爵将驻地迁回不伦瑞克，沃尔芬比特尔宫殿不再有宫廷居住。图书馆却留了下来：戈特霍尔德·埃弗莱姆·莱辛于1770年成为馆长，并曾在旧宫殿的房间里居住。小城数百年的公爵驻地时期结束后，其学术生活仍继续延续。

english:
Wolfsberg lies in the Lavant valley of Carinthia beneath a castle associated with the bishops of Bamberg. Their Carinthian estates included the upper valley, and by the fourteenth century Wolfsberg was the seat of the bishop's representative for those possessions. Its town rights were confirmed in 1331.

In 1425 Hermann of Cilli besieged the town during a dispute over its lordship. A fire destroyed many houses in 1716. Bamberg's long rule ended in 1759, when Empress Maria Theresa purchased its Carinthian possessions, including Wolfsberg, for the Habsburg lands.
simp_chinese:
沃尔夫斯贝格位于克恩滕的拉万特河谷，城堡与班贝格主教的领地密切相关。主教在克恩滕的地产包括河谷上游；到14世纪，沃尔夫斯贝格成为其在当地全部领地的主教代表驻地。1331年城镇权得到确认。

1425年，采列的赫尔曼在领主权争议中围攻城镇。1716年的火灾烧毁许多房屋。1759年，玛丽亚·特蕾西亚女大公购买了班贝格在克恩滕的领地，包括沃尔夫斯贝格，使其转入哈布斯堡统治。

english:
Wolgast stands on the Peenestrom opposite the island of Usedom. A Slavic settlement and castle stood on an island in the channel; a planned town later grew on the mainland. Its town law was confirmed in 1282, and from 1285 Wolgast served as a residence of the dukes of Pomerania. Their palace on Castle Island became the seat of Pomerania-Wolgast.

The town became part of Swedish Pomerania in 1630. In 1713 Russian forces burned Wolgast during the Great Northern War, leaving only a few buildings and churches standing. The town hall was rebuilt in Baroque style. Following Sweden's withdrawal in 1815, Wolgast became part of Prussia.
simp_chinese:
沃尔加斯特位于佩讷海峡岸边，与乌瑟多姆岛隔水相望。斯拉夫聚落和城堡曾位于水道中的岛上，后来大陆岸边兴建了一座规划城镇。1282年当地城镇法获得确认；从1285年起，沃尔加斯特成为波美拉尼亚公爵的驻地，城堡岛上的宫殿是波美拉尼亚—沃尔加斯特的中心。

1630年城镇进入瑞典属波美拉尼亚。1713年大北方战争期间，俄军焚烧沃尔加斯特，仅少数建筑和教堂幸存。市政厅后来以巴洛克风格重建。1815年瑞典撤出后，沃尔加斯特归入普鲁士。

english: Wolhusen was the seat of a powerful family whose lands included the Rottal and Entlebuch valleys west of Lucerne. Around 1300 the lords sold their possessions to the Habsburgs, whose appointed bailiffs came into conflict with Lucerne and the people of Entlebuch. In January 1386 their opponents attacked the bailiff Peter von Thorberg and destroyed both his castles. After the Habsburg defeat at Sempach that year, Lucerne acquired Wolhusen as a pledge in 1389 and obtained full authority in 1405. The settlement remained part of Lucerne's bailiwick of Ruswil until 1798.
simp_chinese: 沃尔胡森曾是一个显赫家族的驻地，其领地包括卢塞恩以西的罗特河谷和恩特勒布赫谷地。约1300年，沃尔胡森领主将产业卖给哈布斯堡家族；哈布斯堡任命的地方长官后来与卢塞恩及恩特勒布赫居民发生冲突。1386年1月，反对者进攻长官彼得·冯·托尔贝格，摧毁了他的两座城堡。同年哈布斯堡在森帕赫战败后，卢塞恩于1389年取得沃尔胡森的抵押权，1405年获得全部统治权。此地直到1798年都属于卢塞恩的鲁斯维尔地方辖区。

english:
Wôlinak, whose Abenaki name means “at the bay”, lies beside the Bécancour River near its meeting with the Saint Lawrence. The river and its islands became home to an Abenaki community whose families came from lands farther south as well as from the surrounding country. Their settlement formed part of a wider network of Abenaki villages and waterways, including the community on the Saint-François River.

In 1704 Abenaki families from the Kennebec country came to Bécancour at the invitation of the French authorities, and in 1708 the local seigneur granted them land. The village moved between sites along the river before settling at Wôlinak around 1735. A visitor in 1752 found a chapel, a priest's house and nineteen wooden dwellings. Tensions over land persisted: in 1757 French settlers set fire to the community's church, and during the War of 1812 further land was seized while many Abenaki were away fighting.
simp_chinese:
沃利纳克位于贝坎库尔河畔，靠近这条河与圣劳伦斯河的汇流处，其阿贝纳基语名称意为“在湾边”。河流与岛屿成为阿贝纳基社群的家园，居民既有来自更南方土地的家庭，也有周边地区的人们。这里与圣弗朗索瓦河畔的社群一样，属于阿贝纳基村庄和水路构成的广泛网络。

1704年，来自肯纳贝克地区的阿贝纳基家庭应法国当局邀请来到贝坎库尔；1708年，当地领主向他们授予土地。村庄在河边几处地点迁移，约于1735年落在沃利纳克。1752年来访的人看到一座小教堂、一所神父住宅和十九间木屋。土地纠纷始终存在：1757年，法国殖民者放火烧毁了社群的教堂；1812年战争期间，许多阿贝纳基人外出作战时，更多土地被人占据。

english:
Wollaston Lake lies on a great divide in the northern Shield. Its waters leave by two different rivers: the Fond du Lac flows west towards Lake Athabasca and the Arctic Ocean, while the Cochrane runs east to Reindeer Lake and the Hudson Bay drainage. Rocky shores and islands break up the lake, which lies within Dene country.

In 1796 David Thompson travelled through this lake country with two Chipewyan guides while seeking a route to Lake Athabasca for the Hudson's Bay Company. They reached the lake by a route that avoided the swift Cochrane River and continued towards the Fond du Lac. The journey showed a possible passage between the two great watersheds, but when Thompson and Malcolm Ross attempted it with heavily loaded canoes later that year, they found it impassable.
simp_chinese:
沃拉斯顿湖位于北方地盾的一条大分水岭上。湖水从两条不同的河流排出：丰迪拉克河向西流往阿萨巴斯卡湖和北冰洋，科克伦河则向东流入驯鹿湖，属于哈得孙湾水系。多岩石的湖岸和岛屿分割着水面，这里也是德内人的土地。

1796年，戴维·汤普森为哈得孙湾公司寻找通往阿萨巴斯卡湖的路线，在两名奇佩维安向导陪同下穿越湖区。他们避开水流湍急的科克伦河，抵达沃拉斯顿湖后继续前往丰迪拉克河。这次旅行展示了两个大流域之间的一条通路；但同年晚些时候，汤普森和马尔科姆·罗斯携带满载货物的独木舟尝试通过，却发现道路无法通行。

english:
Wolmirstedt lies on the Ohre north of Magdeburg. Thietmar of Merseburg mentioned an event there in 1009, and the castle was strengthened in 1208 by Margrave Albert II of Brandenburg in his contest with the archbishopric of Magdeburg.

In 1348 Emperor Charles IV stayed at Wolmirstedt during the political disputes in Brandenburg. The castle chapel was completed in 1480 under Archbishop Ernest of Saxony, and municipal law was established in 1590. The town suffered heavy destruction during the Thirty Years' War.
simp_chinese:
沃尔米施泰特位于马格德堡以北的奥勒河畔。梅泽堡的蒂特马尔记载了1009年发生于此的一件事；1208年，勃兰登堡边侯阿尔布雷希特二世在与马格德堡大主教争夺势力时加强了当地城堡。

1348年，皇帝查理四世在勃兰登堡政治争斗期间驻留沃尔米施泰特。城堡礼拜堂在萨克森的恩斯特大主教任内于1480年建成，1590年颁定市镇法。三十年战争中，城镇遭到严重破坏。

english:
Wołów grew near a castle recorded in 1157, when the surrounding land belonged to the Piast rulers of Poland. Its name derives from the Polish word for an ox, an animal that appears on its old seals. Granted Magdeburg rights around 1285, the town later became a centre of clothmaking and belonged in turn to several Silesian duchies.

Duke Frederick II introduced the Reformation in 1522, shortly before Wołów returned to Piast rule under the dukes of Legnica. The Thirty Years' War reduced its population by half. After the last local Piast died in 1675, the Habsburg authorities closed the parish church to Protestants and gave it to Catholics in 1682. It was returned to the Protestant community in 1707. Prussia annexed the town in 1742, and a serious fire followed in 1781.
simp_chinese:
沃武夫兴起于一座1157年已有记载的城堡附近，当时周围土地属于波兰的皮雅斯特统治者。城名源自波兰语中的公牛，古老的印章上也有这一动物。约1285年，这里获得马格德堡法，后来成为制呢中心，先后属于几个西里西亚公国。

1522年，腓特烈二世公爵推行宗教改革；不久后，沃武夫归入莱格尼察公国，重新由皮雅斯特家族统治。三十年战争使当地人口减少一半。1675年最后一位地方皮雅斯特公爵去世后，哈布斯堡当局于1682年关闭新教徒使用的教区教堂，将其交给天主教徒；1707年，教堂又归还新教社群。1742年，普鲁士兼并城镇，1781年这里又发生严重火灾。

english: Wolvega is a village in the agricultural country between the Linde and Tjonger rivers, first recorded in 1218. Its church was rebuilt in 1646 using material from its medieval predecessor. The fortified house called Lycklama State was erected in the early seventeenth century; Rinco van Lycklama became local magistrate in 1626, though the house had fallen into disrepair and was demolished in 1736. Around 1820 a road from Leeuwarden to Zwolle was built through Wolvega, and in 1835 the village became the administrative centre of Weststellingwerf.
simp_chinese: 沃尔弗哈是林德河与通格尔河之间农业地带的村庄，最早见于1218年的记载。1646年，当地教堂利用中世纪旧教堂的材料重建。十七世纪初，一座称为利克拉马宅邸的设防住宅在此建起；林科·范利克拉马于1626年成为地方长官，但宅邸后来失修，1736年被拆除。约1820年，吕伐登通往兹沃勒的道路穿过沃尔弗哈修建；1835年，村庄成为西斯泰灵韦夫的行政中心。

english: Wŏnju was a principal town of Korea's mountainous eastern interior and the seat of the governor of Kangwŏn. The province took its name from Wŏnju and coastal Kangnŭng when it was established in 1395. Its government compound housed the officials responsible for administering the province. Burned during the Japanese invasion, the buildings were rebuilt in 1634–1635 under successive local magistrates.
simp_chinese: 原州是朝鲜东部内陆山地的重要城邑，也是江原道监营所在地。1395年设立的江原道取名于原州和沿海江陵。监营官衙是官员治理全道的所在；它在日本入侵期间被焚，1634至1635年由历任地方官重建。

english: Wonnarua country lies in the Hunter Valley of eastern Australia, where the river crosses wooded hills and plains. Wonnarua communities are bound together by kinship and an enduring connection to the valley. In the 1820s colonial farms expanded along the Hunter. The loss of access to land and food sources brought raids, reprisals and violent clashes between settlers and Aboriginal people.
simp_chinese: 沃纳鲁阿人的土地位于澳大利亚东部的亨特河谷，河流穿过林木覆盖的丘陵与平原。沃纳鲁阿社群由亲属关系和与河谷的长久联系维系。19世纪20年代，殖民农场沿亨特河扩张；土地和食物来源受限引发了袭击、报复，以及殖民者与原住民之间的暴力冲突。

english: Woodmason Bay is an inlet on the coast of Rutland Island in the southern Andamans. Rugged, forested ground rises behind an intricate shoreline of coves and bays. Mangroves, coral reefs and sandy beaches lie along the island's coast, where sea turtles come ashore to nest. South of Rutland, the waters lead towards Little Andaman and the Nicobar Islands beyond.
simp_chinese: 伍德梅森湾位于南安达曼的拉特兰岛海岸。海岸线曲折，遍布小湾与海岬，后方是崎岖多林的高地。岛岸分布着红树林、珊瑚礁和沙滩，海龟会上岸筑巢。拉特兰岛以南的水域通向小安达曼岛及更远的尼科巴群岛。

english: Woolna, also recorded as Wulna, is a name associated with Aboriginal people of the river country east of Darwin. Tropical woodland and seasonal wetlands extend between the coast and the inland ranges. Neighboring language communities include the Larrakia and Kungarakany to the west and southwest.
simp_chinese: 伍尔纳又写作乌尔纳，是与达尔文以东河流地区原住民有关的名称。热带林地和季节性湿地分布在海岸与内陆山地之间。邻近语言社群包括西方和西南方的拉拉基亚人与昆加拉卡尼人。

english:
Woonsocket stands among the falls and mill streams of the Blackstone valley. Its name recalls the Indigenous people of the surrounding country; Roger Williams used the form Niswosakit when he acquired land from local inhabitants in 1661. The falls later attracted manufacturers seeking water power, and several separate mill villages grew along the river and its tributaries.

In 1810 local partners established the Social Manufacturing Company to spin cotton thread in a small wooden mill on the Mill River. Other enterprises followed around Woonsocket Falls in the 1820s. In 1832 Providence investors bought the Russell mill and established the Woonsocket Mill Company at a village they called Bernon. By the 1830s, textile production was transforming this stretch of the Blackstone into an industrial community.
simp_chinese:
文索基特坐落在布莱克斯通河谷的瀑布与磨坊水道之间。它的名字使人想起周围地区的原住民；1661年，罗杰·威廉斯从当地居民手中取得土地时，曾使用尼斯沃萨基特这一名称。瀑布后来吸引了寻求水力的制造商，河流及其支流沿岸逐渐形成数个独立的磨坊村。

1810年，地方合伙人建立索希尔制造公司，在米尔河畔一座小木厂中纺制棉线。十九世纪二十年代，文索基特瀑布附近又出现其他企业。1832年，普罗维登斯的投资者购入拉塞尔工厂，成立文索基特磨坊公司，并将村庄称为贝尔农。到三十年代，纺织生产正将这段布莱克斯通河谷变成工业社群。

english:
Woppaburra country includes the Keppel Islands off central Queensland. Their ancestors lived on Konomie, Woppa and other islands, travelling between them to gather seasonal foods; the two larger islands provided fresh water. Fish, shellfish, animals and plants supported a maritime life based on detailed knowledge of season and place. The sea was both a source of food and part of a socially understood landscape.

The wider Aboriginal coast contains distinct communities linked through kinship, visiting, ceremonies, and exchange. Named places carry stories, rights, and responsibilities that join practical use with cultural memory. European voyagers later passed nearby waters, followed by expanding colonial interest in the coast and islands. Outside settlement and resource claims brought disease, displacement, and new limits on access, profoundly changing conditions without erasing Indigenous identity and connection. Woppaburra's historical setting therefore centers on an already inhabited maritime country, where local knowledge and cooperation sustained life before foreign charts and governments arrived. Its history includes both the long continuity of relationships with land and sea and the community responses to powerful changes imposed from beyond those shores.
simp_chinese:
沃帕布拉人的家园包括昆士兰中部海岸外的凯珀尔群岛。祖先居住在科诺米、沃帕等岛屿，并在岛间往来采集季节食物；两座较大的岛屿提供淡水。鱼、贝、动物和植物支持海上生活，人们需要熟悉季节与地点。海洋既供应食物，也是具有社会意义的生活空间。

广大原住民海岸包含通过亲族、拜访、仪式和交换联系的不同社区。地名承载故事、权利和责任，将使用与记忆结合。欧洲航海者后来经过，随后殖民利益向海岸岛屿扩展。定居资源主张带来疾病、迁移和使用限制，深刻改变条件，却未抹去身份联系。早已有人海洋土地构成历史中心，地方知识合作先于外国海图政府维系生活。长期陆海关系延续与社区对外来巨大变化的回应共同构成过去，不能只由殖民发现描述。居民持续文化责任也显示这些地点在社会记忆和生活中始终具有不可替代价值。

english: Worabe lies in the southern Ethiopian highlands, in a country once associated with the powerful principality of Hadiya. Its earliest recorded mention dates to the reign of Emperor Sarsa Dengel, when Oromo groups arriving in the area besieged Worabe and Fanfara in 1583–84. The episode belongs to a period of movement and conflict that transformed the political landscape of the southern highlands.
simp_chinese: 沃拉贝位于埃塞俄比亚南部高地，这片地区曾与强大的哈迪亚侯国相关。关于沃拉贝的最早记载出现在皇帝萨尔萨·登格尔统治时期：1583至1584年，抵达此地的奥罗莫人围攻了沃拉贝和凡法拉。这一事件发生在人口迁移与战争改变南部高地政治格局的时期。

english:
Worcester stands on the River Severn, its cathedral overlooking the crossing and the old city. A centre of the church and a market for the surrounding county, it occupied a strategic route between the Midlands and the west. The cathedral became a landmark for armies as well as merchants approaching the city.

In 1651 Charles II brought a Scottish army to Worcester, where Oliver Cromwell defeated him in the last major battle of the British Civil Wars on 3 September. Charles escaped after the defeat, while the city and its people suffered the consequences of fighting. A century later, in 1751, a partnership led by Dr John Wall established a porcelain manufactory beside the Severn, beginning a craft for which Worcester became celebrated.
simp_chinese:
伍斯特坐落在塞文河畔，大教堂俯瞰渡口和古城。它既是教会中心，也是周围郡县的市场，占据连接英格兰中部与西部的战略道路。接近城市的军队和商人都能望见大教堂的身影。

1651年，查理二世率苏格兰军队来到伍斯特，奥利弗·克伦威尔在内战最后一场重大战役中击败了他。查理战败后逃脱，城市和居民则承受战斗的后果。一个世纪后的1751年，一家合伙企业在塞文河畔建立瓷器工场，开启了后来使伍斯特闻名的工艺。

english: Worimi country extends from the Hunter River north to the Manning, encompassing Port Stephens, the Myall Lakes and their hinterland. The Worimi spoke Gathang and lived in a landscape of rivers, wetlands, shore and sea. Beaches provided routes between coastal places, while shell middens and campsites bear witness to long use of the coast.
simp_chinese: 沃里米人的土地从亨特河向北延伸至曼宁河，包括斯蒂芬斯港、迈奥尔湖及其内陆腹地。沃里米人使用加唐语，生活于河流、湿地、海岸与海洋构成的地区。海滩连接沿海各地，贝冢和营地遗址见证了人们对海岸的长期利用。

english:
Worla is a name associated with an Aboriginal people of the Kimberley region of Western Australia. The area lies within country associated with Mangala, whose traditional lands lie in the northwestern Great Sandy Desert.

Aboriginal communities in the wider region maintained ties to named places through language, kinship and inherited knowledge. Movement between water and other resources formed part of life in the dry country.
simp_chinese:
沃拉是与西澳大利亚金伯利地区一个原住民族群相关的名称。这里属于与曼加拉人相关的地区；曼加拉人的传统土地位于大沙漠西北部。

广大地区的原住民社群通过语言、亲属关系和传承知识维持与各地点的联系。在干旱地区，人们在水源和其他资源之间移动。

english:
Worms, once the Celtic Borbetomagus and the Burgundian capital of the Nibelungen legends, lies on the left bank of the Rhine, crowned by the Romanesque cathedral of Saint Peter. It was an imperial free city from the twelfth century: Frederick Barbarossa granted it broad liberties in 1184, and the town council spent the next three centuries contesting the town with its bishop and clergy. Beside the cathedral stood one of the oldest Jewish communities in Europe, with a synagogue consecrated in 1034, a Talmud school Rashi attended, and a cemetery in use since 1058.

The Black Death brought catastrophe. In 1349 the Jewish community was destroyed in the persecutions that followed the plague, and Jews were allowed to settle again only in 1353, confined to a Jewish lane around the synagogue and forbidden to hold land elsewhere. Worms had passed the height of its prosperity by the time King Maximilian held the Reichstag of 1495 here, which introduced an imperial tax, the Imperial Chamber Court and the Perpetual Public Peace. A burghers' uprising in 1512 and 1513 and the feud with Franz von Sickingen from 1515 to 1519 drained the city's finances.

On 18 April 1521 Martin Luther refused to recant before Emperor Charles V at the Diet of Worms, which ended with the Edict of Worms condemning him. The city became a laboratory of the Reformation: the first German evangelical mass was printed here in 1524, and William Tyndale published his English New Testament in Worms in 1526. In 1689 Louis XIV's troops destroyed the city in the War of the Palatine Succession and expelled its people, and ten years passed before urban life resumed. France annexed Worms in 1792, and from 1815 it belonged to Hesse-Darmstadt.
simp_chinese:
沃尔姆斯原是凯尔特人的博尔贝托马古斯，也是《尼伯龙根之歌》传说中勃艮第人的都城，位于莱茵河左岸，罗马式的圣彼得主教座堂高耸于城中。12世纪起，它是帝国自由城市：1184年腓特烈·巴巴罗萨授予它广泛的自由权，此后三个世纪里，市议会一直在与主教和教士争夺城市的控制权。主教座堂旁是欧洲最古老的犹太社区之一，有1034年落成的犹太会堂、拉什曾就读的塔木德学校，以及自1058年起使用的墓地。

黑死病带来灾难。1349年瘟疫之后的迫害使犹太社区被毁灭，直到1353年犹太人才获准重新定居，但被限制在会堂周围的犹太巷内，也不得在别处持有土地。1495年马克西米利安国王在沃尔姆斯召开帝国议会，议会确立了帝国税、帝国最高法院和永久和平令，而此时城市的经济已过了鼎盛时期。1512至1513年的市民起义以及1515至1519年与弗朗茨·冯·济金根的宿怨，进一步拖垮了城市财政。

1521年4月18日，马丁·路德在沃尔姆斯帝国议会上拒绝向查理五世皇帝收回主张，会议以谴责他的《沃尔姆斯敕令》告终。此后这座城市成了宗教改革的试验场：1524年在这里印出了第一部德语福音派弥撒，1526年威廉·廷代尔在沃尔姆斯出版英文新约。1689年，路易十四的军队在普法尔茨继承战争中摧毁此城并驱逐居民，十年后城市生活才恢复。法国于1792年兼并沃尔姆斯，1815年起它归属黑森-达姆施塔特。

english: Worrorra country encompasses parts of the western Kimberley coast, with rugged mainland inlets and islands facing the Indian Ocean. The Worrorra share Wandjina traditions with their Ngarinyin and Wunambal neighbours. Images of these ancestral beings appear in rock shelters, while particular places and waters belong to the histories and responsibilities of local clans.
simp_chinese: 沃罗拉地区包括金伯利西部海岸的一部分，崎岖大陆海湾和岛屿面向印度洋。沃罗拉人与恩加林因、伍南巴尔邻居共享万吉纳传统。祖灵形象出现在岩棚中，特定地点和水域也与当地氏族的历史及责任相联系。

english: The Wotapio were a Cheyenne band whose history joined the peoples of the southern Plains. Their name reflects connections with Lakota communities, and they became closely associated with the Kiowa as well as other Cheyenne. By 1820 the Wotapio had moved south toward the Arkansas River in Colorado, where they camped and hunted alongside Kiowa allies. Kinship and shared journeys linked their camps across the grasslands between the Platte and Arkansas.
simp_chinese: 沃塔皮奥人是夏延人的一个群体，其历史联系着南部平原的不同民族。他们的名称反映了与拉科塔社群的联系，后来又与基奥瓦人及其他夏延人关系密切。到1820年，沃塔皮奥人已南迁至科罗拉多的阿肯色河一带，与基奥瓦盟友共同扎营、狩猎。亲缘关系与共同旅程将普拉特河和阿肯色河之间草原上的营地联系起来。

english: Wotho is a coral atoll in the northern Ralik chain, with islets spaced along a reef around its lagoon. In 1835 the Russian transport America, commanded by Ivan Schantz, sighted Wotho and recorded it as Schantz Islands. The atoll belonged to the Marshallese network of islands and canoe routes long before it appeared on that chart.
simp_chinese: 沃托是拉利克岛链北部的珊瑚环礁，小岛沿潟湖周围的礁盘分布。1835年，伊万·尚茨指挥的俄国运输船亚美利加号望见沃托，将其记为尚茨群岛。出现在这张海图之前，环礁早已属于马绍尔人的岛屿与独木舟航路网络。

english: Wotje is a coral atoll in the Ratak chain, its islets enclosing a broad lagoon in the eastern Marshall Islands. Marshallese communities navigated among the atolls by canoe and maintained relationships with chiefs across the chain. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue spent a month at Wotje, exchanging gifts and learning from islanders; he returned in 1824.
simp_chinese: 沃杰是拉塔克岛链中的珊瑚环礁，小岛环绕马绍尔群岛东部的宽阔潟湖。马绍尔社群乘独木舟往来各环礁，并与岛链上的首领维持关系。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布在沃杰停留一个月，交换礼物并向岛民了解当地情况；他于1824年再次到访。

english: Wotje is a low coral atoll of the eastern Marshall Islands. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue’s Russian expedition entered its lagoon, meeting Marshallese chiefs and navigators. The navigator Lagediack drew a map identifying Wotje and many neighbouring atolls. Coral reefs fringe the low islands.
simp_chinese: 沃杰是马绍尔群岛东部的一座低矮珊瑚环礁。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布的俄国船队进入潟湖，遇见马绍尔酋长和航海者。航海者拉格迪亚克绘制地图，标出沃杰和许多邻近环礁。低矮岛屿的边缘分布着珊瑚礁。

english: Wotje is a low coral atoll in the eastern Marshall Islands of the Pacific. In 1817 Otto von Kotzebue’s Russian expedition entered its lagoon and met Marshallese navigators and chiefs. One navigator, Lagediack, drew a map identifying Wotje and many neighbouring atolls.
simp_chinese: 沃杰是马绍尔群岛东部的一座珊瑚环礁。1817年，奥托·冯·科策布的俄国船队进入潟湖，遇见马绍尔航海者和酋长。航海者拉格迪亚克绘制了一幅地图，标出沃杰及许多邻近环礁。

english: Wotjobaluk country includes the Wimmera River and the lakes of western Victoria. Its waterways link Lake Hindmarsh with Lake Albacutya through Kromelak, or Outlet Creek, when water levels permit. Red gum woodland and wetlands formed part of a landscape cared for by Aboriginal communities with deep connections to the river and its changing waters.
simp_chinese: 沃乔巴鲁克地区包括维多利亚西部威默拉河及湖泊。水位允许时，克罗梅拉克即奥特莱特溪将欣德马什湖与阿尔巴库提亚湖连接起来。赤桉林与湿地构成原住民社群照管的土地，他们与河流及其变化的水域有着深厚联系。

english: Wounta Lagoon belongs to the network of wetlands along Nicaragua’s Caribbean coast. Rivers and coastal channels bring fresh and salt water into lagoons separated from the open sea by low strips of land. The waters support fish and other aquatic life used by Miskito communities along the shore. Together with Pahara and other lagoons farther north, Wounta forms part of an interconnected coastal environment.
simp_chinese: 翁塔潟湖属于尼加拉瓜加勒比海岸的湿地网络。河流与滨海水道将淡水和海水带入潟湖，低平的陆地沙带将潟湖与外海隔开。水域养育着鱼类和其他水生生物，为沿岸米斯基托社群所利用。翁塔与更北方的帕哈拉等潟湖共同构成相互连接的滨海环境。

english: The Wrangell Mountains rise above the Copper River Basin, a great cluster of volcanic peaks covered by snowfields and glaciers. Mount Wrangell, Mount Blackburn, Mount Sanford and Mount Drum are among the summits of this rugged range. Lava flows built the volcanic mountains over immense spans of time, while ice carved their slopes and filled the valleys between them. Rivers descending from the range join the Copper and Chitina, whose basins have long been home to Ahtna communities. Copper deposits in the Chitina country supplied material for tools, ornaments and exchange.
simp_chinese: 兰格尔山脉耸立在铜河盆地之上，火山群峰覆盖着雪原和冰川。兰格尔山、布莱克本山、桑福德山和德拉姆山都是这片崎岖山地的高峰。漫长岁月里，熔岩流堆积成火山，冰川则雕刻山坡，填满其间谷地。从山脉流下的河流汇入铜河和奇蒂纳河，这些流域长期以来都是阿特纳人生活的地方。奇蒂纳地区的铜矿为工具、饰物和交换提供了材料。

english: Pehdzeh Ki lies in the valley of the Deh Cho, the great river also known as the Mackenzie. Dene families travelled through the surrounding country in seasonal groups, hunting and fishing along the river and in the nearby mountains. The North West Company established Fort Alexander at the mouth of the Willowlake River in 1817. Though that post lasted only a few years, it marked the arrival of the fur trade in this part of the valley.
simp_chinese: 佩赫泽基位于德乔河谷。德乔是人们也称作马更些河的大河。德内家庭随季节结伴穿行于周围地区，在河边和附近山地狩猎、捕鱼。1817年，西北公司在威洛莱克河口建立亚历山大堡；虽然这座贸易站只存在了几年，它仍标志着毛皮贸易进入这一段河谷。

sources.title: mvh extension - pehdzeh ki ndeh - dehcho region project description report.pdf

english:
Wrocław, called Breslau by its German merchants, spreads across the islands and channels of the Oder, with the cathedral on its island and a market square lined with merchants' houses around the town hall. The last independent duke of the Wrocław line, Henry VI the Good, died in 1335, and the duchy passed to the Bohemian crown. In 1337 King John abolished the Zaude, the court that had tried people living by Polish customary law. Great fires burned the town in 1342 and 1344, and in 1348 Charles IV bound it firmly to the Lands of the Bohemian Crown.

Breslau grew rich as a staple town on the trade routes between Poland, Bohemia and the Baltic, and joined the Hanseatic League for almost a century until it left in 1474. Matthias Corvinus ruled it from 1469 to 1490, and Polish and Czech forces besieged it in 1474. The Reformation reached the city in 1518, and from 1526 the Catholic Habsburgs ruled Silesia. Breslau backed the Bohemian Revolt in 1618, was occupied by Saxon and Swedish troops in the Thirty Years' War, and lost thousands to plague. The Habsburgs brought Franciscans, Jesuits and Capuchins to rebuild its Catholic life, while the Protestant city's records of births and deaths supplied Edmond Halley with the data for his 1693 life tables. Prussia took Breslau in 1741–42.
simp_chinese:
弗罗茨瓦夫，德意志商人称它为布雷斯劳，铺展在奥得河的岛屿与支流之间，大教堂坐落在河心岛上，市政厅周围的集市广场两侧排列着商人住宅。弗罗茨瓦夫系最后一位独立公爵“善良的”亨利六世于1335年去世，公国随即归入波希米亚王冠。1337年，国王约翰废除了审理依波兰习惯法生活者的扎乌德法庭。1342年和1344年大火两度焚毁城镇，1348年查理四世把它牢固地并入波希米亚王冠领地。

布雷斯劳作为波兰、波希米亚与波罗的海商路上的货物集散地而致富，加入汉萨同盟近一个世纪，直到1474年退出。马加什·科尔文1469至1490年统治此地，1474年波兰和捷克军队围攻该城。宗教改革于1518年传到这里，从1526年起，信奉天主教的哈布斯堡统治西里西亚。布雷斯劳在1618年支持波希米亚叛乱，三十年战争中被萨克森和瑞典军队占领，数千人死于瘟疫。哈布斯堡引入方济各会、耶稣会和嘉布遣会重建天主教生活，而新教城市保存的出生与死亡记录，为埃德蒙·哈雷提供了编制1693年生命表的数据。1741至1742年普鲁士占领布雷斯劳。

english:
Wschowa lies in the border country between Greater Poland and Silesia, where cultivated plains and routes between regional centers support a market town. Agriculture supplies food and materials, while crafts and exchange give urban households livelihoods beyond farming. Its position encourages contact across linguistic and political boundaries, linking local producers with markets in neighboring districts.

In 1343 King Casimir III took Wschowa from the Duchy of Głogów, after which it became a Polish royal town. Clothmaking and trade supported its prosperity. From the mid-sixteenth century it was a centre of the Protestant Reformation; during the Thirty Years' War it received religious refugees from Silesia. In the eighteenth century Polish kings Augustus II and Augustus III often stayed here, and the royal castle hosted political meetings.
simp_chinese:
弗斯霍瓦位于大波兰、西里西亚交界，耕作平原及区域中心之间道路支持市场城镇。农业供应食物、材料，手工和交换使家庭获得耕作之外生计。位置促进跨语言、政治分界接触，将生产者连接到邻区市场。地方经济因此同时依赖乡村资源及较广工艺、商业关系，边地并非只有军事意义。

1343年，卡齐米日三世从格沃古夫公国夺取弗斯霍瓦，此后它成为波兰王家城市。制呢和贸易支持城市繁荣。十六世纪中叶起，这里成为新教改革中心之一；三十年战争期间，又接纳来自西里西亚的宗教难民。十八世纪波兰国王奥古斯特二世和三世常驻此地，王家城堡也举办政治会议。

english: Wu'an lies in the Taihang foothills of southwestern Hebei, on the border with Shanxi. It was already a town of the Zhao state in the Warring States period and a county under the Han, long before the fourteenth century. The hills hold some of the richest iron ore in northern China, and the old furnace sites at Guzhen and nearby towns show that smelting went on here for centuries, while the villages below grew wheat, persimmons, walnuts and wild jujubes and raised the local Wu'an sheep. The Cishan site on its slopes holds traces of millet farmers who settled the foothills thousands of years earlier.
simp_chinese: 武安位于河北西南部的太行山东麓，与山西接壤。战国时这里已是赵国的城邑，汉代设县，远在十四世纪之前。山中蕴藏着华北最富的铁矿之一，固镇等地的古炼铁炉遗址说明这里冶铁已有悠久的历史；山下的村庄种小麦、柿子、核桃和野枣，也养本地的武安羊。山坡上的磁山遗址留有几千年前在此定居的粟作农民的遗存。

english: Wucao lies in the uplands northwest of Qiubei, in the country once governed from Weimo. Its name was also written with the characters for Five Cao, and the surrounding country formed part of the complex of local districts recorded in the gazetteers of Yunnan. In the seventeenth century the Qing abolished Weimo Prefecture and reorganized its territory; the lands around Qiubei eventually came under Shizong. Hills and small valleys divide this upland region.
simp_chinese: 五嶆位于丘北西北方的高地，旧属维摩地区，又写作五曹。云南地方志所记的诸乡、嶆分布在这片山地之中。十七世纪，清朝裁撤维摩州，重新划分其辖地；丘北一带后来归师宗州管理。起伏的丘陵与小河谷分隔着这片高地。

english:
Wǔchāng county lay on the southern bank of the Yangtze, a country of lakes and rice fields across the river from Huángzhōu. It kept the name Sūn Quán gave the old town of È in 221, when he made it his capital, 'to prosper through arms'. Its fishermen worked the eddies at Fánkǒu, where the Fán River brings the waters of Liángzi Lake into the Yangtze, and the county gazetteer ranked the bream caught there first under heaven.

In 1080 Sū Shì, banished to Huángzhōu, often crossed to the West Hill of Wǔchāng and there rebuilt a ruined pavilion dating from Sūn Quán's time; his brother Sū Zhé wrote its record. Under the Yuán and Míng the county answered to Wǔchāng Route and then Wǔchāng Prefecture, whose seat lay upriver at Jiāngxià, so that one name came to mean two places.
simp_chinese:
武昌县在长江南岸，湖泊与稻田相间，与黄州隔江相望。221年孙权在古鄂县建都，取“以武而昌”之义改名武昌，县名一直沿用下来。渔人在樊口一带捕鱼，梁子湖水经樊川在这里汇入长江，水流回旋，县志称此处所产的鳊鱼“甲天下”。

1080年，贬居黄州的苏轼常渡江游武昌西山，重建了孙权时始建、早已荒废的九曲亭，其弟苏辙为之作记。元明两代，武昌县先后隶属武昌路、武昌府，路府治所却在上游的江夏，“武昌”一名从此同时指着两座城。

english: Wuchuan lies north of the Yin Mountains at the end of the White Road, a route through the range from the southern plain. The Northern Wei established a military town here in the fifth century to defend its northern frontier. Long after the old garrison disappeared, the name endured. Under the Yuan the surrounding pastures were occupied by the Ongud, and later by the Tumed Mongols.
simp_chinese: 武川位于阴山北麓，白道穿越山岭，从南方平原通到这里。北魏于五世纪设武川镇，守卫北方边境。旧镇早已消失，地名却延续下来。元代附近草场为汪古部牧地，后来又成为土默特蒙古人的牧地。

english: Wúchuān lies near the mouth of the Jiàn River on the coast of western Guangdong. Its county seat at Wúyáng was laid out around crossing streets, with a magistrate's office, temples and a Confucian school. The county took its name from the river, formerly called Wúchuān, when it was established under the Sui in 598. Its school was founded in 1348 and repeatedly repaired under the Ming and Qing. A Ming pagoda near the coast also served as a landmark for vessels approaching the river mouth.
simp_chinese: 吴川位于广东西部海岸、鉴江入海口附近。明清县城设于吴阳，街道纵横交会，城内有县衙、庙宇和学宫。隋开皇十八年（598年）设县时，因境内旧称吴川的河流而得名。县学始建于元至正八年（1348年），明清多次修葺；海边的明代双峰塔也为驶近河口的船只提供了地标。

english: Wuchuan lies in the wooded mountains north of Sinan, near the approaches to Sichuan. Its valleys have long been home to Gelao communities as well as other peoples of the Guizhou highlands. The district came under the hereditary rulers of Sizhou and later Sinan. After the Ming replaced the Sinan native administration with a prefecture governed by appointed officials, Wuchuan became a county under its authority. The county seat connected the surrounding mountain settlements with the administrative centre farther south.
simp_chinese: 婺川位于思南以北的林山之间，靠近通往四川的道路。河谷中长期居住着仡佬等族群。这里先后属思州和思南土司管辖；明朝以流官治理思南府后，婺川县隶属其下。县治将周围山间聚落与南面的府城联系起来。

sources.title: 务川仡佬族苗族自治县

english: Wǔdāng Mountain rises above the valleys of northwestern Húběi, its temples and palaces dedicated to Daoist worship. A bronze hall cast in 1307 bears the marks of the Wǔchāng workshop that made its pieces, assembled like a timber building. In 1412 the Míng court expanded the Nányán Palace as part of a great programme of building on the mountain.
simp_chinese: 武当山耸立在湖北西北的山谷之上，宫观供奉道教神祇。1307年铸造的一座铜殿按木构建筑方式拼装，构件上留有武昌作坊的铭文。明永乐十年（1412年），朝廷扩建南岩宫，成为武当山大规模营建的一部分。

english: Wudi lies on the low salt coast of northern Shandong, facing the Bohai Sea, where ancient shell ridges mark old shorelines. The name belongs to the oldest geography of Qi: in the Zuo Zhuan the Qi minister Guan Zhong claimed the land as far as Wudi to the north. The historical Wudi county stood elsewhere; the Ming town here was Haifeng. Its present site was walled in 1357 near the end of the Yuan, and in 1373 the Ming set up Haifeng County with its seat there, an arrangement the Qing kept.
simp_chinese: 无棣位于山东北部低平的盐碱海岸，面向渤海，古老的贝壳堤标出昔日的海岸线。这个名字属于齐国最古老的地理记忆：《左传》里齐国的管仲宣称齐国之地北至无棣。历史上的无棣县治在别处，这里的明代城镇名叫海丰。今县城在元末至正十七年（1357年）筑成，洪武六年（1373年）明朝设海丰县，县治即在此地，清代沿用。

english: Wudjari country lies in the southeastern part of Noongar country, along the southern coast of Western Australia and into the country behind it. Wudjari people belong to a wider network of Noongar communities, each with its own relationship to country. Their homeland includes coastal waters and the inland landscape beyond the shore.
simp_chinese: 伍贾里人的土地位于努恩加地区东南部，沿西澳大利亚南海岸向腹地延伸。伍贾里人属于更广阔的努恩加社群网络，各社群都与自己的土地保持联系。他们的家园包括沿海水域以及海岸后方的内陆地区。

english: Wǔfēng lies among the high ridges of southwestern Hubei, in country once governed by hereditary native chiefs. The Ming established the Wǔfēng Shíbǎo native office in 1373; after a period of abolition, it was restored in 1407. Mountain roads were difficult to maintain: a record written by the Róngměi chief Tián Shùnnián in 1693 describes improvements to a route through the region. In 1735 the Qing replaced native rule with appointed officials and established Chánglè County here.
simp_chinese: 五峰位于湖北西南重山之间，旧时由世袭土官治理。明洪武六年（1373年）设五峰石宝长官司，废除后又于1407年恢复。山区道路艰难，容美土司田舜年于1693年撰文记述修整山路的经过。清雍正十三年（1735年）改土归流，在此设长乐县。

english:
Wugang stands in the hills of southwestern Hunan, near the Zi River and the wooded heights of Yunshan. Long a military and administrative centre, it was elevated to a prefecture under the Yuan and became a subprefecture of Baoqing under the Ming. Its walls and princely residence mark a turbulent history on the edge of the mountain country.

In 1346 the Yao leader Wu Tianbao rose against the Yuan and twice took Wugang. After another uprising in 1371, the Ming general Wu Liang rebuilt the town's earthen defences in stone. The Prince of Min moved his court here in the fifteenth century, and successive princes enlarged the fortified city. In 1647 the Southern Ming Yongli Emperor briefly made Wugang his capital before retreating westward in the face of Qing armies.
simp_chinese:
武冈位于湖南西南丘陵间，附近有资江和林木葱郁的云山。这里长期是军事与行政重镇，元代升为路，明代降为宝庆府属州。城墙与王府见证了山地边缘动荡的历史。

1346年，瑶族首领吴天保起兵反元，曾两次攻入武冈。1371年又有起事，明将吴良随后将土城改筑为石城。十五世纪岷王迁居武冈，历代岷王不断扩建城垣。1647年南明永历帝短暂以此为行都，后在清军进逼下向西退走。

english:
Wugongshan rises in the mountains of western Jiangxi, its high ridges crowned by the Golden Summit. Long revered as a Daoist mountain, it also became a home to Buddhist communities. Stone altars near the summit recall the worship that drew pilgrims up its steep slopes.

Daoist temples damaged in the wars at the end of the Yuan were rebuilt in the early Ming. Under the Jiajing Emperor, an envoy and a Daoist master were sent to pray on the mountain for the health of the emperor's mother. Buddhist institutions flourished here as well: in 1553, disciples established a monastery at Jiulongshan, a northwestern branch of the range.
simp_chinese:
武功山耸立于江西西部群山之中，高岭之上有金顶。这里长期是道教名山，也有佛教僧众驻锡。峰顶附近的石砌祭坛，见证了信众登山祈祀的悠久传统。

元末战乱中受损的道观在明初得到重建。嘉靖年间，朝廷曾遣官员和道士前来为皇太后祈福。山中的佛教亦有兴盛之时：1553年，僧人在武功山西北支脉九龙山创建禅林，传法于附近山地。

english:
Wǔhé belongs to the Huai river lowlands, where several waterways connect agricultural districts across a landscape vulnerable to flood and changing channels. Farming uses fertile ground, while fishing and river transport provide other resources. Boats and roads link villages with market and administrative centers. The timing and control of water are essential to local prosperity, making drainage, embankments, and cooperation important parts of everyday political and economic life.

Wǔhé county was established in 1271 under the Southern Song, taking its name from the meeting of five rivers, including the Huai. Its administrative affiliations changed under successive dynasties: in the Ming it came under Fengyang prefecture, and in 1724 it was placed under Si prefecture. River channels also changed over time; local accounts describe recurring floods where the waterways met.
simp_chinese:
五河属于淮河低地，多条水道连接农业地区，景观容易受到洪水和河道变化影响。肥沃土地支持耕作，捕鱼河运提供其他资源。船只道路联系村庄、市场及行政中心。水流时机和控制关系繁荣，使排水、堤坝及合作成为日常政治经济生活重要部分。

南宋于1271年设五河县，县名源自淮河等五条河流汇聚。此后行政隶属随朝代变化：明代属凤阳府，1724年改属泗州。河道也随时间变迁；地方记载提到河流汇合处反复发生水患。

english:
Wuhu stands where the Qingyi River meets the Yangtze, a port drawing boats and goods from the hills and waterways of southern Anhui. Its compact walled town belonged to Taiping Prefecture under the Ming and Qing. Merchants, craftsmen and artists gathered on its streets, giving rise to a distinctive local art in iron.

The Ming rebuilt Wuhu's walls, completing them in 1581. In the early Qing, the blacksmith Tang Peng became associated with the making of iron pictures, hammering and shaping metal into the forms of painting. A well-known account tells how he watched the neighbouring painter Xiao Yuncong at work before turning his own craft to images. Later generations of smiths continued the art in the town.
simp_chinese:
芜湖位于青弋江汇入长江之处，舟船带来皖南山地与水乡的货物。明清时期，这座城池不大的江港属太平府，商人、工匠和画家聚集街市，也孕育出别具特色的铁画。

明代重筑芜湖城墙，于1581年竣工。清初铁匠汤鹏以锤锻铁材作画而闻名。相传他常观看邻居、画家萧云从作画，后来将铁匠技艺用于表现画意。此后芜湖工匠继续传承这门手艺。

english:
Wujal Wujal lies in the tropical river and coastal country of northeastern Queensland. Rainforest, streams and nearby shores provide varied resources; fishing, hunting and gathering rely on knowledge of seasons and local conditions. Heavy rain affects travel, while paths and waterways connect different places.

Aboriginal communities across northeastern Queensland maintained distinct languages and responsibilities toward Country. Exchange, visits and ceremony sustained relationships between neighbours, while inherited knowledge helped people use different environments. European contact and later settlement profoundly affected Indigenous land and life.
simp_chinese:
乌贾尔乌贾尔位于澳大利亚东北昆士兰的热带河流与海岸地区。雨林、溪流和附近海岸提供多种资源；捕鱼、狩猎和采集需要熟悉季节及环境。强降雨影响出行，而道路与水道连接着不同地方。

昆士兰东北部的原住民社群拥有各自的语言和与土地相关的责任。交换、探访与仪式维系邻近人群之间的联系，世代传承的知识帮助人们利用不同环境。欧洲人的接触及其后定居给原住民土地和生活带来深刻影响。

english:
Wújí belongs to the central Hebei plain, where cultivated fields and roads connect local villages with the administrative and commercial centers of northern China. Grain production supports households and markets, while livestock and crafts add other resources. The relatively open landscape favors movement, though seasonal rain, drought, and river conditions influence work and transport. Local prosperity depends on both agricultural labor and reliable links with neighboring districts.

In 1374, during the Ming dynasty, Wuji was assigned to Zhending prefecture. The county remained under that prefecture after it was renamed Zhengding in 1723 under the Qing. County institutions organized taxes, labor, and public order through relationships with village households and local elites. Markets and religious establishments connected communities beyond formal administration, while warfare and political transitions imposed further pressures on the plain.
simp_chinese:
无极属于河北中部平原，耕地和道路把村庄连接到中国北方行政商业中心。粮食生产支持家庭市场，牲畜和工艺补充资源。较开阔景观便利移动，季节降雨、干旱及河流条件却影响劳动运输。繁荣同时依赖农业劳动和邻区可靠联系。

明洪武七年（1374年），无极县改属真定府。清雍正元年（1723年）真定府改名正定府，无极仍属其管辖。县级机构通过村落家庭与地方精英组织税收、劳役和公共秩序；市场及宗教场所也将社区联系起来。战争与政治更替则可能给平原上的生活带来压力。

english:
Wujiang lies south of Suzhou, where the Grand Canal crosses the watery plain near Lake Tai. Mulberry trees, silkworms and looms sustained a network of villages and market towns. Among them, Shengze became known for woven silk, while nearby Zhenze was a centre for trading raw silk.

In the early Ming, Wujiang households hired skilled weavers from Suzhou to work their looms. By the later fifteenth century local people had mastered the craft, and silk workshops spread around Shengze and Huangjiaxi. In the early Qing, merchants arrived from great distances to buy cloth, and the trade encouraged the planting of mulberry trees throughout the southern part of the county. Silk linked the work of rural households to markets far beyond the canal towns.
simp_chinese:
吴江位于苏州以南，运河穿过太湖附近的水乡平原。桑树、蚕室和织机维系着村落与市镇；盛泽以丝绸织造著称，附近震泽则是蚕丝集散地。

明初吴江人曾雇请苏州熟练织工操作机杼，到十五世纪后期，本地人逐渐掌握技艺，盛泽与黄家溪一带的织坊随之发展。清初，远方商人云集买绸，贸易又推动县南广植桑树。乡村家庭的劳动因此与运河市镇之外的广大市场相连。

english: Wujiang is a crossing on the river south of Bozhou, where a steep road descends to the water between high hills. An old relay route linked the crossing with the country to the north and south, and a fortified pass guarded the approach. During the Ming campaign against Yang Yinglong in 1600, imperial troops fought their way across the river, but the Bozhou forces inflicted a heavy defeat on one army here. After the campaign the Ming restored a relay station at Wujiang, keeping the crossing on the route between Sichuan and Guizhou.
simp_chinese: 乌江是播州以南的渡口，险峻道路从高山间下抵江边。古驿道连接南北，关隘守护着渡江的入口。1600年明军征讨杨应龙时，一路兵马在此渡江进攻，遭播州军重创。战后明朝重设乌江驿，使这处渡口继续承担四川与贵州之间的驿路交通。

english: Wujiang lies on the northern bank of the Yangtze, west of Nanjing. Tradition associates it with the last stand of Xiang Yu, the defeated king of Chu. Pursued after the battle of Gaixia in 202 BC, he reached Wujiang, where a ferryman offered to carry him across the river. Xiang Yu refused to return to Jiangdong in defeat and died on its bank. The story made this crossing a place remembered in poems and historical accounts for centuries.
simp_chinese: 乌江位于南京以西的长江北岸，相传是楚霸王项羽兵败身死之地。公元前202年垓下之战后，项羽被追至乌江，亭长备船劝他渡江。他自觉无颜见江东父老，拒绝渡河，最终死于江边。此后历代诗人与史家反复讲述这一故事，使渡口成为追怀楚汉兴亡之处。

english:
Wujin shared the walled city of Changzhou, a centre of learning and commerce on the Grand Canal. The canal ran through the city and joined its waterways to the Yangtze and Lake Tai. Fields, market streets and boat traffic sustained a district long known for its scholars as well as its produce.

In 1368 the Ming moved the local courier station outside the western gate, where officials and dispatches passed along the canal route. Markets spread along the water during the dynasty, with grain, cotton cloth and combs among the prominent trades. Wujin also furnished scholars to the Donglin circle: Qian Yiben joined Gu Xiancheng and others in teaching and debating public affairs at the academy in nearby Wuxi.
simp_chinese:
武进与常州府共处一城，是大运河边的商业与文教中心。运河穿城而过，连接长江、太湖及江南水网，舟船往来，田野与街市共同支撑这片以士人和物产著称的地区。

1368年，明朝将驿站迁至城西门外，官员与公文循水陆驿路往来。明代市集延伸到运河两岸，粮米、棉布和梳篦交易兴盛。武进士人也参与东林讲学：钱一本与顾宪成等人在邻近无锡的东林书院议论学问和时政。

english: Wujing, the Five Wells, refers to the salt-producing country of Yunlong in western Yunnan. Brine rose in the Bi River valley, where communities boiled it with firewood from the surrounding mountains. In 1382 the Ming established a salt administration at Nuodeng to oversee the wells. Salt production supported villages and markets linked by roads used to carry salt and horses through the highlands. By the sixteenth century the district's network of wells had grown beyond the original five.
simp_chinese: 五井是云南西部云龙一带盐井的总称。沘江河谷涌出卤水，居民取周围山林的柴薪煎盐。1382年，明朝在诺邓设立盐课提举司，管理盐务。盐业养育了沿井而兴的村落和市集，运盐与驮马的道路将它们连接起来。到十六世纪，这一带的盐井已由最初的五井扩展。

english:
Wukari became a leading centre of the Jukun peoples of the middle Benue, with a sacred ruler known as the Aku. His authority rested on his role as intermediary between his people, their ancestors, and the gods; through him they sought rain and good harvests. Jukun chiefdoms across the valley acknowledged his religious leadership, even where they had rulers of their own.

Tradition associates the founding of Wukari with a succession dispute at Bye-pi, a former centre of Kwararafa. The claimant Katakpa left with followers and crossed the Donga, establishing a settlement that grew into Wukari. By the eighteenth century the Jukun were firmly established along the middle Benue, and the institutions centred on the Aku reached beyond the town itself.
simp_chinese:
武卡里成为贝努埃河中游朱昆人的重要中心，神圣的统治者称为阿库。他的权威建立在沟通人民、祖先和诸神的职责之上；人们通过他祈求降雨和丰收。河谷各地的朱昆酋邦即使有自己的统治者，也承认他的宗教领袖地位。

传说武卡里的建立与夸拉拉法旧中心拜皮的一场继承争端有关。王位竞争者卡塔克帕带领追随者离开，渡过栋加河，建立了后来发展为武卡里的聚落。到18世纪，朱昆人已在贝努埃河中游牢固立足，以阿库为中心的制度也超出了城镇本身。

english: Wular Lake spreads across the Vale of Kashmir, fed by the Jhelum River and the Madhumati and Arin streams. Its waters swell and recede with the seasons. In old Sanskrit texts the lake was called Mahapadmasaras, and it was also known as Ullola, a name associated with its rising waves. Sultan Zain-ul-Abidin is said to have ordered an artificial island, Zaina Lank, built in the lake in 1444.
simp_chinese: 武勒尔湖的水面铺展在克什米尔谷地，杰赫勒姆河及马杜马蒂、阿林两条溪流注入湖中。湖水随季节涨落，面积也随之变化。古代梵文典籍称它为摩诃钵头摩湖，它还有一个与翻腾波浪有关的名字乌洛拉。相传苏丹宰因·阿比丁于1444年下令在湖中修筑人工岛宰纳兰克。

english: Wulensi is a town of Nanung, a kingdom of northern Ghana whose ruler sits at Bimbilla. The chief of Wulensi is one of the local leaders within this wider polity, where chiefs and elders held courts in their communities. Nanung's origin tradition names Mmantambu as its founder and relates him to the ruling families of neighboring Dagbon and Mamprugu. Its name is understood to combine the words for a chief and a hand.
simp_chinese: 武伦西是加纳北部纳农王国的一座城镇，王国统治者驻于宾比拉。武伦西酋长是这一政体内的地方领袖之一，酋长与长老在各自社群主持议事。纳农的起源传统称曼坦布为创建者，并将他与邻近达格邦、曼普鲁古的统治家族联系起来。纳农之名据说由“酋长”和“手”两个词组成。

sources.title: 11261138Asian and African Studies 2 2019 05 Skalnik.P SUCCESSION AND DEMOCRACY IN NANUŊ, NORTHERN GHANA.pdf

english: Wulgurukaba country includes the coast and islands around Cleveland Bay, as well as waterways reaching inland toward the Reid River. The name Wulgurukaba means canoe people, reflecting a close connection with the sea and rivers. Magnetic Island lies offshore within their traditional country.
simp_chinese: 乌尔古鲁卡巴人的土地包括克利夫兰湾周围的海岸和岛屿，也包括向内陆延伸至里德河的水道。乌尔古鲁卡巴意为“独木舟人”，反映了他们与海洋及河流的密切联系。近海的磁岛也在其传统土地之内。

english: Wulian Mountain rises among the wooded hills south of Zhucheng, its peaks and ravines surrounding a Buddhist temple beneath Dabei Peak. Formerly known as Wuduo, the mountain received the name Wulian from the Wanli Emperor. In 1602 the monk Mingkai founded Guangming Temple with imperial support; the court provided funds, scriptures and ritual objects, and an imperial eunuch supervised construction. Later repairs and stone inscriptions preserved the story of the temple and its mountain setting.
simp_chinese: 五莲山耸立于诸城以南的林木丘陵间，峰峦与山谷环绕着大悲峰下的佛寺。山原称五朵，万历皇帝赐名五莲。1602年，僧人明开在朝廷支持下创建光明寺，皇室拨给经费、经书和法器，并派宦官督建。此后寺院屡经修葺，碑刻记下了这座山寺的历史。

english: Wuliehe was a post in the basin of the Tym on Sakhalin, where the island's rivers and forests met networks extending across the strait to the Amur. Under the Yuan, Ainu elders brought tribute to Wuliehe and received gifts in return, making the post a place of exchange as well as political contact. The Ming later maintained relations with Sakhalin leaders; in 1431 an official associated with Wuliehe presented marten pelts as tribute.
simp_chinese: 兀烈河是库页岛特姆河流域的一处历史据点，岛上的河流和森林通过跨海峡的联系与黑龙江地区相连。元代，阿伊努长老在此进贡并接受赏赐，使据点成为政治往来与交换之地。明朝后来继续与库页岛首领交往；1431年，一位与兀烈河有关的官员进献貂皮。

english:
Wuling is the county town of Changde, standing on the Yuan River where the mountains of western Hunan open onto the plain west of Dongting Lake. Its walls are traced back to 277 BC, when Zhang Ruo, governor of Shu for Qin, seized the lands south of the Yangtze and built a city east of the present district. The Han made it the seat of Wuling Commandery, and the Sui and Tang knew it as Langzhou.

In 1117 the Song set up the Changde military prefecture, taking the word from a line of the Book of Songs, and about 1165 it became a prefecture. The Yuan made it Changde Circuit, and the Ming and Qing kept Wuling as the seat of Changde Prefecture under Huguang and later Hunan. From here officials governed the counties along the Yuan and the lake country to the west, and the town was called the throat of Guizhou and Sichuan and the lips and teeth of western Chu, a gateway to the southwestern uplands. In 1376 the Ming also placed Lizhou and its counties under Changde, pushing the prefecture's reach northwards.
simp_chinese:
武陵是常德的附郭县城，位于沅江之滨，湘西的山地在这里向洞庭湖以西的平原展开。其城池可追溯到公元前277年，秦国蜀守张若攻取江南之地，在今武陵区城东筑城。汉代这里是武陵郡治，隋唐时称朗州。

北宋政和七年（1117年），朝廷取《诗经》“常德”一语之意，设常德军，约1165年升为常德府。元代为常德路，明清两代武陵仍是常德府治，先后隶属湖广与湖南。官员由此管理沅水沿岸各县和西面的湖区，这座城素有“黔川咽喉”和“西楚唇齿”之称，是通往西南山地的门户。明洪武九年（1376年），澧州及其属县也划归常德府，府的辖境向北扩展。

english: The Wǔlíng Mountains extend across the borderlands of Hunan, Hubei, Guizhou and Sichuan. Their ridges are cut by the Qīng, Yǒu, Lǐ and other rivers, creating a country of deep valleys and scattered uplands. Tujia communities have long inhabited these mountains alongside Miao, Han and other peoples. Hereditary chiefs governed many valleys under the Yuan and Ming, before Qing reforms replaced much of their authority with appointed officials in the eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 武陵山脉横亘湘、鄂、黔、川交界地区，清江、酉水、澧水等河流切开山岭，形成深谷和分散高地。土家族与苗、汉等族群长期生活于此。元明时期，许多山谷由世袭土司治理；十八世纪清朝推行改土归流，大片地区改由朝廷任命的官员管理。

english: The country around Wull-Wull lies among inland plains and watercourses west of Queensland’s Great Dividing Range. The Dawson and Condamine river systems rise in the wider region and flow toward different basins. The Wulli Wulli people are associated with the country west of the ranges of the Gureng Gureng.
simp_chinese: 乌尔乌尔一带位于昆士兰大分水岭以西的内陆平原与水道之间。道森河和康达明河水系发源于广大地区，流向不同流域。乌利乌利人与古伦古伦人山地以西的土地相联系。

english: Wulong lies along the Wu River, among the limestone hills and valleys southeast of Fuzhou. The old county seat at Tukan stood south of a ridge and north of the river, on unusually deep and fertile soil in a district otherwise dominated by karst. The county was established in the Tang, and its settlement continued through the Ming and Qing. A stone arch bridge built in the Ming joined the eastern and western parts of the old town.
simp_chinese: 武龙位于涪州东南，乌江穿行于石灰岩山岭和谷地之间。旧县城土坎背靠山岭，南临乌江，土层深厚肥沃，在喀斯特地貌为主的地区颇为难得。武龙县设于唐代，城镇延续至明清；明代修建的一座石拱桥连接旧城东西两部分。

english: Wūluó was a native chiefship in the mountains of northeastern Guizhou. In 1413 it was placed under the newly established Wūluó Prefecture; when the prefecture was abolished in 1438, the office passed to Tóngrén. Its seat did not remain in one place. After the old seat was burned in 1568, it was moved to Hēipō and then, in 1572, to Xiǎozhài. These changes give a glimpse of the shifting centres of local rule within a region governed through hereditary chiefs.
simp_chinese: 乌罗是贵州东北山地的一处土司辖地。明永乐十一年（1413年）新设乌罗府，乌罗土司归其管辖；正统三年（1438年）乌罗府被撤销后，土司改隶铜仁。土司衙署并非始终固定一处：隆庆二年（1568年）旧治被焚后，衙署迁往黑坡，四年后又迁至小寨。这些迁徙留下了世袭地方政权在山地中变动的痕迹。

english: Wumeng lay on the high plateau of northeastern Yunnan, among the mountain routes linking Sichuan with the southwest. Its prefecture was ruled by hereditary Yi chiefs, whose authority continued through the Ming and into the Qing. Local communities lived amid high ridges, valleys and cultivated basins, while the ruling family held office in the name of the imperial court. In 1726 Qing armies advanced into Wumeng as part of a campaign to replace hereditary chiefs with appointed officials.
