The change was accompanied by fighting and was followed by a reorganisation of administration in the region. The old Wumeng prefecture was brought under Yunnan's provincial government, and its political order was reshaped.
simp_chinese: 乌蒙位于滇东北高原，山路连接四川与西南各地。乌蒙府由彝族世袭土司统治，这一体制历经明代，延续至清初。居民生活在山岭、河谷和坝地之间，统治家族则受朝廷封授官职。1726年，清军进入乌蒙，推行以流官取代世袭土司的政策。这一变革伴随着战争，随后地方行政也被重新安排。旧乌蒙府划归云南省管辖，当地的政治格局随之改变。

english: Wunambal country lies in the northern Kimberley around the Mitchell and Row rivers and the deeply indented coast. Wunambal and Gaambera people share Wanjina Wunggurr traditions with Worrorra and Ngarinyin neighbours. Ancestral beings and their images connect rock shelters, waters and clan lands across this rugged landscape.
simp_chinese: 伍南布伊位于金伯利北部伍南巴尔人的土地，涵盖米切尔河、罗河及曲折海岸一带。伍南巴尔与冈贝拉人同沃罗拉、恩加林因邻居共享万吉纳－温古尔传统。祖灵及其形象将这片崎岖地区的岩棚、水域和氏族土地联系起来。

english: The southern Yellow Sea off Jiangsu is a world of shallow water, sandbanks, and tidal channels. Great deposits left by the ancient Yangtze and Yellow rivers underlie the radiating shoals, while tides have shaped extensive mudflats along the coast. These shifting banks form a broad transition between the mainland shore and the open sea.
simp_chinese: 江苏外海的南黄海遍布浅水、沙洲和潮汐水道。古长江与古黄河留下的沉积物构成辐射沙洲的基础，潮流则塑造出沿岸广阔的滩涂。变化的沙洲在大陆海岸和外海之间形成宽阔的过渡地带。

english: Wuning lies on the Xiu River in the hills of northwestern Jiangxi. West of the county town, Liushan Academy stood where the Tang official Liu Hun had once withdrawn to read. Founded under the Southern Song, it was destroyed in the wars at the end of the Yuan and rebuilt in the Ming. Another academy was established east of the river during the Wanli reign, with a lecture hall and student rooms; after flooding submerged its site, it was moved to the western gate.
simp_chinese: 武宁位于赣西北修水沿岸，丘陵环绕。县城西面的柳山书院建于唐代柳浑隐居读书之处，南宋始建，元末毁于战乱，明代重建。万历年间，官员又在修江东设云龙书院，建讲堂和生舍；后来旧址受水淹没，书院迁至西门。

english: Wunnumin lies beside the lake of the same name in the forested homeland of the Oji-Cree. A local tradition connects the red earth around the lake with the killing of a great beaver. Before the community at the lake grew, families from this country travelled to the Big Beaver House trading post, established in 1808, to exchange furs and obtain supplies.
simp_chinese: 温努明坐落在同名湖畔，处于奥吉克里人的森林故土。当地传说将湖边的红土与一只巨型海狸被杀的故事联系起来。湖畔社区发展之前，这一带的家庭曾前往1808年设立的大海狸屋贸易站，用毛皮交换所需物资。

english: Wunsiedel lies in the Fichtelgebirge of northeastern Franconia. Its castle guarded a ford over the Röslau and a crossing of old roads; the settlement is recorded in 1163. The burgraves of Nuremberg acquired lordship over the castle in 1285 and granted Wunsiedel town rights in 1326. Under their Hohenzollern successors it became part of the margraviate of Bayreuth. Tin mining made the town an important regional centre until around 1450, while local smiths produced tinplate. The Hussite wars disrupted this metalworking in the fifteenth century. Wunsiedel remained within the Bayreuth principality until 1791, its history shaped by the resources and routes of the wooded uplands.
simp_chinese: 文西德尔位于法兰克尼亚东北部的菲希特尔山地区。当地城堡守卫勒斯劳河的浅滩和两条古道交会处，聚落见于1163年的文书。纽伦堡城堡伯爵1285年取得城堡的领主权，1326年授予文西德尔城市权利；其霍亨索伦家族继承者后来统治拜罗伊特侯国，文西德尔亦属该国。锡矿开采使城镇在约1450年以前成为重要的地区中心，当地铁匠还制作镀锡铁皮。十五世纪的胡斯战争扰乱了金属加工。文西德尔直到1791年仍属拜罗伊特，其历史与森林高地的资源及道路紧密相连。

english:
Wuntho was a Shan principality in the hills west of the Irrawaddy, between the great river and the Chindwin. The Mangin Range runs through its territory, dividing wooded highlands from the valleys and settlements below its slopes. Its rulers held the title of sawbwa, and the state formed part of the chain of northern principalities with which the kings of Burma maintained relations.

Local tradition preserves a long succession of Wuntho rulers. In the late eighteenth century Maung Tha Ywe became sawbwa and ruled into the nineteenth, during the era of the Konbaung dynasty. Wuntho's position west of the Irrawaddy set it apart from the better-known Shan states east of that river, though it shared their tradition of hereditary chiefs.
simp_chinese:
温梭是伊洛瓦底江以西山地中的掸族小邦，位于伊洛瓦底江与钦敦江之间。芒因山脉贯穿其境，将林木覆盖的高地与下方河谷隔开。统治者称为土司，小邦是与缅甸诸王保持关系的北方诸邦之一。

地方传统保存了一长串温梭统治者的名字。十八世纪末，貌达瑞成为土司，其统治延续至十九世纪，正值贡榜王朝时期。温梭位于伊洛瓦底江以西，有别于江东较为人熟知的掸邦，但同样保持世袭首领的传统。

sources.title: Shwe-Zin-Maw-2015-The Uneasy Subordinate Alliance The Relations between Myanmar and the Shan State in Late Nineteenth Century-en.pdf

english: Wǔpíng lies in the inland hills of western Fújiàn, near the river from which it takes its name. The Wǔpíng River is a tributary of the Tīng, whose waters run south through the borderlands. Once a Táng-era town, Wǔpíng became a county in 994 under the Sòng and later belonged to the prefecture of Tīngzhōu.
simp_chinese: 武平位于福建西部内陆山地，因境内的武平河得名。武平河是汀江支流，江水向南穿过闽粤边地。武平唐代为镇，北宋淳化五年（994年）升为县，后来属汀州府。

english: Wuping occupies an old fortified site in the Aohan country north of the Daling River. Under the Liao it was known as Wu'an, a prefectural town, before the Jin used the name Wuping. The town's walls belonged to a network of Liao settlements across the country around the Middle Capital. Under the Mongols the place lent its name to Wuping, an administrative district later associated with Daning.
simp_chinese: 武平位于大凌河以北敖汉一带的古城址。辽代此地为武安州，金代称武平；城墙是辽中京周围州县城址网络的一部分。蒙古统治时期，武平之名又用于地方行政建置，后与大宁的建置相联系。

english: Wuqiao lies beside the Grand Canal in southeastern Hebei and is renowned for its acrobats. Performers from the district developed an occupational culture with its own rules, inherited skills, and secret language. By the Ming period their performances were recorded in local writing, and travelling troupes used spoken introductions and songs accompanied by gongs. They honoured the immortal Lü Dongbin as a patron of their craft, which continued to flourish under the Qing.
simp_chinese: 吴桥位于河北东南的大运河畔，以杂技艺人闻名。当地艺人形成了自己的行规、传艺方式和行业隐语。明代已有吴桥杂技的文字记载，流动班社表演时使用说口与锣歌，并奉仙人吕洞宾为行业祖师。这门技艺在清代继续兴盛。

english: Wuqing lies on the northern Grand Canal between Tianjin and Beijing. Its flat, watery country was crossed by the boats that carried grain towards the capital. A relay station was established at Yangcun on the canal in 1293, and it became busier under the Ming as the government improved the waterway to supply Beijing and the northern garrisons. Villages and landing places lined the river through the county.
simp_chinese: 武清位于天津与北京之间的北运河沿岸。运粮船穿行于低平水乡，将南方漕粮送往京城。1293年，朝廷在杨村设驿；明代整修运河、保障京师和北方驻军粮饷，使杨村驿的任务日益繁重。河道两岸分布着村落与码头。

english: Wuro Yolde lies in the country around Hong, south of the Biu uplands and west of the mountains towards Mubi. Kilba and Marghi communities inhabit this part of the upper Benue region. The Kilba kingdom maintained its own rulers in the Hong country, where it faced pressure from the expanding Fulani emirate of Adamawa in the early nineteenth century. Its resistance to that power forms part of the history of the lands between the Benue and the southern approaches to Bornu.
simp_chinese: 武罗约尔德位于洪一带，在比乌高地以南、通往穆比的群山以西。基尔巴人和马尔吉人居住在贝努埃河上游的这一地区。基尔巴王国在洪附近拥有自己的统治者，十九世纪初面临不断扩张的富拉尼阿达马瓦埃米尔国的压力。基尔巴人对这一势力的抵抗，是贝努埃河与博尔努南部之间地区历史的一部分。

sources.title: 384264767 KILBA HEGEMONY AND RESISTANCE TO FULANI ADAMAWA EMIRATE AND BRITISH RULE IN ADAMAWA PROVINCE OF NORTHERN NIGERIA 1809-1960

english:
Würzburg rose as a Franconian stronghold, becoming a bishopric in 741. It flourished around its fortress and Main River trade routes in the early Middle Ages.

In 1168 Frederick Barbarossa granted Bishop Herold the ducal dignity at a diet held here, and from then on the bishops ruled as princes and called themselves dukes in Franconia. The townsmen never fully accepted their lord. They rose against him again and again until, in 1400, the bishop's army crushed them at Bergtheim, and Würzburg remained a bishop's city to the end of the old Empire. When the Peasants' War reached the Main in 1525, the rebels stormed the fortress of Marienberg above the river and failed, and the sculptor Tilman Riemenschneider, a councillor who had refused to march against them, was held prisoner in the fortress.

Julius Echter von Mespelbrunn, prince-bishop from 1573 to 1617, made the city a bastion of the Counter-Reformation. He refounded the university in 1582, built the great hospital that bears his name and rebuilt Marienberg as a Renaissance palace, while he banished the Lutherans, most of whom settled in nearby Schweinfurt, and hunted witches; more than 260 people in the bishopric were executed for witchcraft early in the 17th century. Swedish occupation from 1631 to 1634 briefly reversed his work. From 1699 the prince-bishops, above all the Schönborns, rebuilt the city in Baroque splendour, crowned by the Residenz that Balthasar Neumann raised for them between 1720 and 1744. Their state ended in 1802, when Würzburg passed to Bavaria, and after a few years as capital of a grand duchy under Ferdinand of Tuscany it returned to Bavaria in 1814.
simp_chinese:
维尔茨堡作为法兰克尼亚的要塞崛起，于741年成为主教区。中世纪早期，它凭借要塞与美因河贸易路线逐渐繁荣。

1168年，红胡子腓特烈在此地召开的帝国会议上授予主教海罗德公爵尊位，此后历任主教以诸侯身份统治，并自称法兰克尼亚公爵。市民始终不肯完全服从这位领主，一次又一次起来反抗，直到1400年主教的军队在贝格特海姆击溃市民，维尔茨堡从此一直是主教的城市，直到旧帝国终结。1525年农民战争蔓延到美因河畔，起义者猛攻河岸高处的玛丽恩贝格要塞，未能得手；雕刻家蒂尔曼·里门施奈德身为市议员，曾拒绝出兵镇压起义者，事后被关押在这座要塞里。

1573年至1617年在位的诸侯主教尤利乌斯·埃希特·冯·梅斯佩尔布龙，把这座城市变成了反宗教改革的堡垒。他在1582年重建大学，兴建以他命名的大医院，把玛丽恩贝格改建成文艺复兴式宫殿；同时他驱逐路德派信徒，他们大多迁往邻近的施韦因富特，他还大肆搜捕女巫，17世纪初主教领地内有260多人以巫术罪被处决。1631年至1634年的瑞典占领一度推翻了他的成果。1699年起，历任诸侯主教，尤其是舍恩博恩家族出身的几位，以巴洛克的气派重建城市，其中最壮丽的是巴尔塔萨·诺伊曼在1720年至1744年间为他们建成的维尔茨堡宫。1802年主教领地终结，维尔茨堡归入巴伐利亚，此后作为托斯卡纳的斐迪南治下大公国的首府过了几年，1814年又回到巴伐利亚。

english:
Wurzen stands on the Mulde east of Leipzig. It was recorded in 961, and in the early twelfth century Herwig, bishop of Meissen, founded a collegiate church there. The bishops' castle and church made Wurzen an ecclesiastical centre as well as a river crossing.

In 1581 the town passed to the elector of Saxony. During the Thirty Years' War Swedish troops sacked Wurzen in 1637 and much of it burned. The town later recovered, remaining a local centre on the route between Leipzig and Dresden.
simp_chinese:
武尔岑位于莱比锡以东的穆尔德河畔，961年见于文献。12世纪初，迈森主教赫尔维希在此建立教士会教堂；主教的城堡与教堂使武尔岑既是渡河地点，也是教会中心。

1581年，城镇转入萨克森选侯统治。三十年战争期间，瑞典军队于1637年洗劫武尔岑，城镇大部分被焚毁。此后它逐渐恢复，继续作为莱比锡至德累斯顿道路上的地方中心。

english: Wusa occupied the high country around Weining, where the uplands of Guizhou meet those of Yunnan. It was ruled by hereditary chiefs within a network of Yi territories that included neighbouring Shuixi. The mountains and basins formed the setting for communities whose local leaders held land and authority under successive dynasties. After the Qing suppressed resistance led by the Shuixi chief An Kun in 1664, the government reorganised the region and made Wusa the seat of Weining prefecture under appointed officials. Local headmen nevertheless continued to exercise authority in many rural districts, so the change at the top did not erase older patterns of landholding and rule.
simp_chinese: 乌撒位于威宁一带的高地，是贵州与云南高原交接之处。当地由世袭土司统治，与邻近水西等彝族领地组成相互联系的地区。各朝之下，地方首领在山岭和坝子间掌有土地与权力。1664年，清廷镇压水西土司安坤的抵抗后，重新划分当地，在乌撒设威宁府，派遣流官治理。但许多乡村仍由土目行使地方权力，因此府一级的变革并未抹去原有的土地和统治关系。

english: Wushan stands beside the Yangtze at the western approach to Wu Gorge. Steep peaks rise above the river, their clouds and changing light inspiring stories and poems for centuries. Among them is the Goddess Peak, whose slender rock was likened to a woman watching over the gorge. The tale of the goddess and the king of Chu, recorded in the ancient Gaotang rhapsody, gave the mountains a lasting place in Chinese literature.
simp_chinese: 巫山位于长江边，紧邻巫峡西口。陡峭群峰高出江面，云雾和变幻的光影数百年来激发了无数传说与诗篇。十二峰中的神女峰有一块修长岩石，宛如守望峡江的女子。古代《高唐赋》所载楚王与巫山神女的故事，使此山在中国文学中留下深远印记。

english: The Wu Mountains rise on either side of the Yangtze as it cuts through Wu Gorge. The celebrated Twelve Peaks stand above steep wooded slopes and mist-filled water, their shapes changing with the clouds. Among them is Goddess Peak, a narrow stone pinnacle associated with the ancient tale of a goddess who appeared to a king of Chu. For travellers on the river, the mountains marked one of the most striking passages through the Three Gorges.
simp_chinese: 长江穿过巫峡，巫山群峰耸立于两岸。著名的十二峰凌驾于陡峭林坡和云雾笼罩的江水之上，随云光变幻而呈现不同姿态。其中神女峰有一座细长的石峰，与古代楚王梦遇神女的故事相联系。对于江上的旅人，这群山是穿越三峡时最令人难忘的一段景色。

english: The Wusun Mountains form a ridge of the Tian Shan between the Ili valley and the Tekes basin. Their western continuation is known as the Ketmen range. The northern slopes fall toward the Ili through steep wooded gorges, while the southern side opens onto the high Tekes country. Forests and mountain grasslands cover the slopes, and passes carry routes between the valleys on either side.
simp_chinese: 乌孙山是天山的一条山脊，横亘在伊犁河谷与特克斯盆地之间，西段称为凯特门山。北坡经陡峭、林木繁茂的峡谷下降至伊犁河谷，南坡则面向特克斯高地。森林与山地草场覆盖坡面，穿越山脊的隘口连接两侧谷地。

english: Wuthathi country lies near the northern end of Cape York Peninsula. Wuthathi people are among the traditional owners of the Jardine River catchment, alongside Anggamudi and Yadhaigana people. Their homeland includes tropical wetlands and country approaching the eastern coast of the peninsula.
simp_chinese: 伍塔蒂人的土地位于约克角半岛北端附近。伍塔蒂人与安加穆迪、亚达伊加纳人共同是贾丁河流域的传统主人。其家园包括热带湿地及通向半岛东海岸的土地。

english: Wutun lay in the hill country west of Wuzhou, a region caught up in the conflicts of the mid-Ming. The Wuzhou prefectural gazetteer records campaigns and negotiations involving communities of Wutun during the Jingtai and Tianshun reigns. In the 1460s and 1470s officials also recruited people from Wutun to cultivate land in Cangwu, granting fields and registering grain obligations. Their movement linked mountain communities to farmland around the prefectural city.
simp_chinese: 五屯位于梧州以西的丘陵地带，明代中期曾卷入地方冲突。梧州府志记载了景泰、天顺年间官府对五屯等地的征讨与招抚。十五世纪六七十年代，官府又招募五屯居民到苍梧开垦，拨给田地并登记粮额，使山中社群与府城附近的耕地发生新的联系。

english: Wúwéi lies between Cháo Lake and the Yangtze in central Ānhuī. The Rúxū River flows east from the lake through this country toward the great river. Under the Míng, Wúwéi was a prefectural seat, its jurisdiction encompassing land that had belonged to several ancient counties in the old Lújiāng commandery.
simp_chinese: 无为位于安徽中部、巢湖与长江之间。濡须水从巢湖向东流过这一地区，通往大江。明代无为为州治，其辖地曾包括古庐江郡下属数县的土地。

english:
Wuxi lies between Lake Tai and the Yangtze, a market town on the Grand Canal amid the rice fields and waterways of Jiangnan. Under the Song, merchants from every quarter hauled their goods to its fairs, which ran for more than a month, and when the Yuan raised it to a prefecture in 1295 it was counted the foremost town of western Zhe. Its name means 'without tin', though Wang Mang once briefly renamed it Youxi, 'having tin'.

In 1604 Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong, both dismissed from office, rebuilt the Donglin Academy where the Song thinker Yang Shi had once taught. Its lectures drew hundreds, a couplet in its hall bade scholars care for 'the affairs of family, state and realm', and their outspoken judgement of officials earned them the name of the Donglin party. In 1626, with orders out for his arrest, Gao Panlong drowned himself in a pond, and the eunuch Wei Zhongxian had the academy torn down; it rose again once the Chongzhen Emperor lifted the ban.
simp_chinese:
无锡位于太湖与长江之间，是大运河畔的一座市镇，四周是江南的稻田与水网。宋代每逢集市，四方商贾运货而来，一连月余才散；1295年元朝升无锡为州，时称“浙右名邑之冠”。“无锡”字面意思是“没有锡”，王莽时却一度改名“有锡”。

1604年，先后罢官还乡的顾宪成与高攀龙，在宋代理学家杨时讲学旧址重建东林书院。讲会听者常达数百人，堂上对联写着“家事国事天下事，事事关心”；东林士人好品评朝中官员，被政敌称为东林党。1626年，魏忠贤派人缉拿高攀龙，他投水自尽，书院也被下令拆毁，直到崇祯帝解除党禁才得以重建。

english:
At the heart of the Yangtze delta, Sūzhōu, anciently known as #italic Gusu#! and as the Sòng-era #italic Píngjiāng#!, was founded in the 6th century BC as the capital of the kingdom of Wú. Set amid an intricate web of canals that earned it the proverbial pairing with Hángzhōu, 'Heaven above, Sūzhōu and Hángzhōu below', the city has long been famed for its silk weavers, its garden estates of the literati, and the refinement of its cuisine and opera. Under the Southern Sòng it grew into one of the wealthiest cities of the south, and though the Mongol conquest of 1276 left scars, by the early 14th century the gardens, pagodas, and canal-side markets of Sūzhōu are once again drawing the merchants and scholars of all China.

Late in the Yuán, Zhāng Shìchéng made Sūzhōu his capital and styled himself Prince of Wú, until Zhū Yuánzhāng's army broke through its walls in 1367. Under the Míng and Qīng it grew richer than ever on silk. By the later Míng its looms stood in workshops where the master put up the money and hired weavers their labour, and the Hǔshù customs post outside the walls collected the second-highest revenue among the empire's eight great customs stations. Such wealth drew the court's tax commissioners: in 1601, when Sūn Lóng laid new levies on the looms, the workshops shut and the weaver Gě Xián led the crowds that besieged his office until he fled to Hángzhōu. Under the Qīng, Sūzhōu ranked among the four great commercial centres of the realm, and rice from the middle Yangtze poured into Fēngqiáo outside its gates, the largest grain market in China.
simp_chinese:
苏州地处长江三角洲腹地，古称#italic 姑苏#!，宋时称#italic 平江#!，始建于公元前6世纪，为吴国都城。城内河道纵横，水网交织，世人皆谓“上有天堂，下有苏杭”。此地素以丝绸织造、文人园林、精致饮食及戏曲艺术闻名。南宋时期，苏州成为江南最富庶的城市之一。虽在1276年蒙古征服时受创，但至14世纪初，园林、佛塔与运河沿岸市集再度繁荣，吸引着全国各地的商贾与文人汇聚于此。

元末张士诚以苏州为都，自称吴王，直到1367年朱元璋的军队攻破城池。明清两代，苏州靠丝绸更加富庶。明代后期，城中出现了“机户出资，机工出力”的织造作坊，城外的浒墅关钞关税收在全国八大钞关中名列第二。财富也招来了朝廷的税监：1601年孙隆对织机加征重税，机户停工，织工葛贤率众包围税监衙门，孙隆逃往杭州。到了清代，苏州位列天下四大商业中心之一，长江中游的米粮源源运来，城外的枫桥成了全国最大的粮食市场。

english: Wuxian was a county on the Qian River in central Guangxi. Established under the Tang, it belonged to Xiangzhou through the Song and Yuan. In the Ming period it took the name Wuxuan, and in 1431 the county seat was moved from its old site on the Yin River to a new site by the Qian. A Confucian temple was founded in the same year, giving the county a place for worship and learning.
simp_chinese: 武仙是广西中部黔江流域的一处县邑。县置于唐代，宋元时期属象州。明代改名武宣，1431年县治从阴江旧址迁至黔江之畔的新址。同年当地兴建文庙，为县中祭祀和学习提供了场所。

english:
Wǔxiāng lies in southeastern Shanxi among the hills of the upper Zhuozhang River, between the Taihang and Taiyue ranges. In the Yuan it was one of the three counties of Qinzhou, with Tongdi and Qinyuan. In 1369 the Ming merged the seat county, Tongdi, into the department, which answered directly to the province; in 1595 Qinzhou was briefly placed under Fenzhou Prefecture, and in 1607 it returned to provincial control. The Qing kept it as a directly administered department.

At Gucheng, the seat of Nieshi County in the Eastern Han, stands the Dayun Temple, once a monastery named Yanjing and renamed in 1064 under the Northern Song. Its Hall of the Great Hero is a building of the Jin dynasty, while the Guanyin Hall and the side halls were added in the Ming and Qing, so that several centuries of building gather around the Jin hall into a complete old temple.
simp_chinese:
武乡位于山西东南部，浊漳河上游的丘陵地带，处在太行山与太岳山之间。元代它是沁州所辖的三县之一，另外两县是铜鞮和沁源。1369年明朝将州治铜鞮县并入州，州直属行省；1595年沁州一度改隶汾州府，1607年又恢复直属布政使司。清朝仍把沁州作为直隶州。

故城镇是东汉涅氏县的旧治，大云寺就坐落在这里。寺院原名岩静寺，北宋治平元年（1064年）改称大云寺。寺中大雄宝殿是金代原构，观音殿和东西配殿则建于明清，几个世纪的营造就这样围绕金代的老殿层层积累下来，成为一处完整的古寺。

english: Wuxing, the old heart of Huzhou south of Lake Tai, is renowned for silk and writing brushes. Its waterways connect a country of mulberry cultivation with towns where silk is reeled and woven, while skilled brush makers supply the tools of scholars and painters. Under the Yuan, Wuxing's calligrapher Zhao Mengfu belonged to a circle of scholars whose association with local craftsmen helped establish the fame of Huzhou brushes. Ming writers praised the brush makers of Wuxing, and the region's silk towns likewise grew as centres of specialised production and trade.
simp_chinese: 吴兴是太湖南岸湖州的旧中心，以丝绸和毛笔闻名。当地水网连接着种桑养蚕的乡村与缫丝织绸的市镇，制笔匠人则为文人和画家提供用具。 元代吴兴书画家赵孟頫及其文人圈与本地笔工的交往，有助于湖笔声名鹊起。明代文人称赞吴兴的制笔技艺，湖州的丝业市镇也逐渐发展为专业生产与贸易中心。

english: Wuyang is a county town on the plain south of the Sha River. An old geographical account describes springs southeast of the town whose bubbling waters gave rise to a stream, and a lake to the north. The county's walls required repeated attention in the Qing: in 1658 the magistrate Zhang Jin repaired all four gate towers, and later officials had damaged stretches of wall, battlements and a defensive platform restored.
simp_chinese: 舞阳是沙河南面的平原县城。旧地理书说，城东南的舞水泉泉水涌跃，流成一条小河；城北还有湖泊。清代县城墙多次需要维修：1658年知县张尽重修四座城楼，后来官员又修复坍塌的城墙、垛口和敌台。

english: Wuyi lies on the low plains of southern Hebei, east of Hengshui. The county takes its name from an ancient settlement associated in local tradition with Wuluo. Rivers and old channels cross its territory, including the Fuyang, which served as a route for water transport. Its history as a county reaches back many centuries, through changing administrations on the northern plain.
simp_chinese: 武邑位于河北南部低平的平原，衡水以东。县名源于古代聚落，地方传统将其与武罗联系起来。滏阳河及旧河道穿过这一地区，其中滏阳河曾供水运使用。历代行政建置变迁之下，武邑作为平原县邑已有悠久历史。

english: Wuyi lies in the hill country south of Jinhua. Among its settlements is Guodong, a village enclosed by wooded hills and home to generations of the He family. Its buildings include the family ancestral hall, constructed during the Wanli reign of the Ming dynasty. The hall gave the lineage a place to honour its ancestors, while the village's houses and paths reflected its setting among the hills.
simp_chinese: 武义位于金华以南的山地间。县境内的郭洞村四周山林环抱，何氏家族世代居住于此。村中的何氏宗祠建于明万历年间，为族人祭祀祖先提供场所；村舍与道路也顺应着周围山势布局。

english: The Wuyi Mountains rise along the borderlands of Fujian and Zhejiang, their forested ridges sheltering a rich variety of plants and animals. In the dramatic gorges of the Nine Bend River stand temples and the remains of academies. The Song scholar Zhu Xi lived and taught in the mountains, and his work helped make Wuyi a centre from which Neo-Confucian learning spread across East Asia.
simp_chinese: 武夷山脉绵延于福建与浙江的边界地带，林木覆盖的山岭庇护着丰富的动植物。九曲溪峡谷间有寺庙和书院遗址；宋代学者朱熹曾在山中居住讲学，他的学问使武夷成为理学重镇，并从这里传播到东亚各地。

english: The Wǔyí Mountains rise in northern Fújiàn, where the winding Nine-Bend Stream cuts among steep red cliffs. Their forests shelter a rich variety of plants and animals, while the valleys have long attracted scholars. Confucian academies stood among the mountains from the Sòng onward, and Zhū Xī taught and wrote here, giving Wǔyí a lasting place in the history of learning.
simp_chinese: 武夷山耸立于福建北部，九曲溪蜿蜒穿过陡峭的红色岩峰。山中森林孕育着丰富的动植物，幽谷也长久吸引着文人学者。宋代以来，山间兴建了许多书院；朱熹在此讲学著述，使武夷山在学术史上占有重要地位。

english:
Wùyuán lies in the wooded hills of northeastern Jiāngxī on the border with Ānhuī and Zhèjiāng. Cut in 740 from Xiūníng and Lèpíng, it came under Huīzhōu in the Sòng and in 1295 the Yuán raised it to Wùyuán Subprefecture. In 1357 Zhū Yuánzhāng made Huīzhōu Xīng'ān Prefecture and in 1367 renamed it Huīzhōu again; in 1369 Wùyuán returned to county status, one of the six counties of Huīzhōu until the end of the Qīng. Its streams flow to the Poyang basin, carrying tea and timber down to Jiāngxī.

Wùyuán belonged to the merchant country of Huīzhōu, whose traders ranged across the empire during the Míng and Qīng. Its hills also yielded the Lóngwěi inkstones prized by scholars, and clan halls and villages in its valleys recall the lineages that sent merchants and scholars out of the county.
simp_chinese:
婺源位于江西东北部的山林间，与安徽、浙江交界。唐开元二十八年（740年）自休宁和乐平析置，宋属徽州，元元贞元年（1295年）升为婺源州。至正十七年（1357年）朱元璋改徽州路为兴安府，至正二十七年（1367年）又改徽州府，明洪武二年（1369年）婺源复为县，直到清末都是徽州府六县之一。境内溪流汇入鄱阳湖水系，茶叶和木材顺流而下运往江西。

婺源属于商贾辈出的徽州，明清时期徽商足迹遍及全国。当地山中出产龙尾砚，深受文人珍视；山谷间的宗祠和村落，也留下了送出商人与学者的宗族痕迹。

english: Wuyuan was a county north of Nanning, in a landscape of cultivated plains and limestone hills. Its seat moved north from the Yong River during the Song, and moved again at the beginning of the Ming. Originally under Nanning, the county was transferred to neighbouring Si'en prefecture in 1577, a connection retained throughout the Qing. The old name survived for centuries as the county and its surrounding settlements grew.
simp_chinese: 武缘是南宁以北的旧县，境内平地与石灰岩山丘相间。宋代县治从邕江一带北迁，明初又迁至新址。武缘原属南宁府，万历五年（1577年）改隶邻近的思恩府，清代仍沿袭这一建置。武缘这一旧名伴随着县治和周边聚落延续了数百年。

english: Wǔzhài was a small hereditary native office in the mountain country of western Hunan. Its territory lay among the Miao communities between the larger jurisdictions of Bǎojìng and Fènghuáng. During the early Qing, the Fènghuáng administration and the Wǔzhài chief's office operated from the same town, bringing appointed and hereditary authorities into close contact. In 1727 the Qing reorganised the native jurisdictions of the region, and land of Wǔzhài was included in the new Bǎojìng County.
simp_chinese: 五寨是湘西山地的一处小型世袭土司，辖地位于保靖与凤凰之间的苗族社群地区。清初凤凰厅与五寨长官司曾在同一城中办公，流官与土官的权力相邻。雍正五年（1727年），清廷调整当地土司建置，以保靖宣慰司及五寨长官司辖地设保靖县。

english: Wuzhi lies north of the Yellow River, where controlling floods was a constant concern. In 1723 the Yongzheng emperor ordered a temple built here after work to close a breach in the riverbanks. Completed in 1726 and named Jiayingguan, it honoured river gods and officials who had worked on flood control. Offices for river administration stood beside the shrine, joining worship and practical management in one complex.
simp_chinese: 武陟位于黄河北岸，治河防洪是当地长期面临的事务。1723年，雍正帝为纪念堵塞河堤决口而下令建庙，1726年竣工，赐名嘉应观。这里祭祀河神和治河功臣，旁边还设有河务官署，将祭祀与治水行政结合在一起。

english: Wuzhou was a frontier department in the uplands of northwestern Shanxi. Its old walled site in the Wuzhou uplands belongs to the Liao, Jin and Yuan periods, when authority over these uplands changed between northern dynasties. The Jin and Yuan retained the department after its establishment under the Liao. The early Ming abolished Wuzhou, but its old city continued to serve the frontier: troops of the Zhenxi guard were stationed there as an agricultural garrison.
simp_chinese: 武州是晋西北高地上的旧边州。大武州附近的古城属于辽、金、元时期，见证了北方王朝在此地的更替。武州由辽设置，金、元沿用；明初撤州后，旧城仍有边防用途，镇西卫军士驻此屯田。

sources.title: 五寨县各级文物保护单位列表

english: The Wyaconda River begins as two branches in southern Iowa, which flow southeast into Missouri and join before reaching the Mississippi. Its course passes through a landscape of rolling uplands and wooded valleys. The name is derived from a Dakota word connected with sacred power. Along with the neighbouring Des Moines and Chariton rivers, the Wyaconda drains the country between the Missouri and Mississippi, carrying its waters east to the great river.
simp_chinese: 怀阿康达河由发源于艾奥瓦南部的两条支流形成。两支向东南流入密苏里，汇合后注入密西西比河。河水穿过起伏高地与林木河谷，名称源于一个与神圣力量有关的达科他语词。怀阿康达河与邻近的得梅因河、查里顿河一道，为密苏里河和密西西比河之间的土地排水，将水流带往东面的大河。

english: Wyborn Reef lies near the eastern approaches to Torres Strait, where shallow coral reefs and islands interrupt the sea between Cape York and New Guinea. The strait’s waterways have long connected island communities. Navigators entering from the Coral Sea had to find passages among the reefs and shoals.
simp_chinese: 怀伯恩礁位于托雷斯海峡东入口附近，浅珊瑚礁与岛屿点缀着约克角和新几内亚之间的海域。海峡水道长期连接着岛屿社群。从珊瑚海驶入的航海者必须在礁石与浅滩之间寻找通道。

english: High Wycombe lies in the valley of the River Wye among the Chiltern Hills. Its market served the surrounding countryside, while watermills supported the production of corn and cloth. Paper making became important in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, and chairmaking grew from a cottage craft into a substantial local industry. By the early nineteenth century small workshops were making furniture for the London market, drawing on the skills of the town and its neighbourhood.
simp_chinese: 海威科姆坐落在奇尔特恩丘陵间的怀伊河谷中。市场服务周围乡村，水磨坊则支持谷物加工和布匹生产。十七至十八世纪，造纸业日益重要，制椅也从家庭手艺发展为当地的重要行业。到十九世纪初，小作坊利用镇上及附近的工艺，为伦敦市场制作家具。

english: Wyomissing takes its name from a creek in the Schuylkill valley, where Lenape people lived along its banks. The stream flows eastward to join the Schuylkill opposite Reading, and its name has been understood to refer to a place of flats. On eighteenth-century maps it appeared as Wymissing Creek, a small waterway within the larger Delaware river system.
simp_chinese: 怀俄米辛得名于斯库尔基尔河谷的一条溪流，勒纳佩人曾居住在它的岸边。溪水向东流去，在雷丁对岸汇入斯库尔基尔河；其名字被认为有“平坦之地”的意思。十八世纪的地图将它记作怀米辛溪，它是特拉华河水系中的一条小支流。

english:
Wyrzysk lies in northern Greater Poland, where cultivated land, woodland, and river routes connect inland districts with the approaches to Pomerania. Agriculture and livestock support villages, while a market town provides crafts, services, and exchange. Roads gather traffic from a wider rural hinterland, though wet ground and seasonal weather can complicate movement. Local prosperity rests on the regular relationship between fields, households, and regional markets.

Wyrzysk was first mentioned in surviving records in 1326 and became a town under Magdeburg law in 1565. The wider Krajna region belonged to the Polish political world near the Pomeranian border. Town privileges and landed estates shaped local economic life, while seventeenth-century wars disrupted the wider region. The partitions of Poland brought Prussian rule in the eighteenth century, changing government and obligations while local markets continued to serve the countryside.
simp_chinese:
维日斯克位于大波兰北部，耕地、森林与河流路线，把内陆辖区连接到波美拉尼亚方向。农业牲畜支持村庄，集镇提供工艺、服务和交换。道路汇集广大乡村腹地交通，湿地及季节天气却可能使通行复杂。地方繁荣建立在田地、家庭和地区市场之间的定期关系上，稳定生产需要交通与制度共同支持。

维日斯克在现存文献中首次出现于1326年，1565年依马格德堡法成为城镇。更广的克拉伊纳地区属于波兰政治世界，靠近波美拉尼亚边界。城市特权和庄园影响地方经济，十七世纪的战争扰乱了周边地区。十八世纪波兰被瓜分后，普鲁士取得统治，行政与义务随之改变，地方市场仍服务于乡村。

english:
Xacona belongs to the fertile valley country of western Michoacán, where water and cultivated ground support maize, gardens, and varied local production. Communities exchange food, craft goods, and resources from neighboring uplands, linking settlements through markets and familiar paths. The landscape lies within western Mesoamerica, whose political and cultural traditions differed from those of the central Mexican basin. Productive valleys can support dense relationships even when surrounding hills make travel more demanding.

Jacona was subject to Purépecha territorial and tributary authority before the Spanish conquest. Its earlier settlement, known as Jacona la Vieja, was distinct from the present town site. In the sixteenth century Augustinian friar Sebastián de Trasierra promoted the community's move to the present location, traditionally dated to 1555. The change came amid a wider reorganization of Michoacán under Spanish rule, while Indigenous communities continued to cultivate land and sustain local ties.
simp_chinese:
沙科纳属于米却肯西部肥沃谷地，水源和耕地支持玉米、园地及多样地方生产。社群交换食物、手工货物和邻近高地资源，通过市场及熟悉路径联系聚落。这里位于美索美洲西部，政治文化传统不同于墨西哥中部盆地。丰饶谷地能够支持密切关系，即使周围丘陵使旅行更困难，地方生产也能通过持续交换接入广大网络。

西班牙征服以前，哈科纳处于普雷佩查政权的领土和贡赋控制之下。较早的聚落称为老哈科纳，与现在的镇址不同。十六世纪奥古斯丁会修士塞瓦斯蒂安·德·特拉谢拉推动居民迁往现址，传统上将这一迁移定于1555年。这一变化发生在西班牙统治下米却肯地区重组的过程中，原住民社区继续耕作并维系地方联系。

english: Xagal lies in the dry country of northern Somalia, between the Gulf of Aden and the inland plateau. The coastal plain known as the Guban gives way to the rising slopes of the Golis Mountains, where the climate becomes cooler and rainfall more abundant. Somali pastoralists have traditionally moved their herds between the coast, the highlands and the Haud, following the seasonal changes in grazing and water.
simp_chinese: 哈加勒位于索马里北部干旱地带，介于亚丁湾与内陆高原之间。被称为古班的海岸平原逐渐过渡到戈利斯山脉上升的坡地，气候也随之变凉，雨水更加丰沛。索马里牧民历来随着水草的季节变化，带领牧群往返于海岸、高地和豪德地区。

english: The lower Limpopo spreads across a broad floodplain before reaching the Indian Ocean. Sand dunes rise above the low-lying land, and river and sea together shape the waterways near the coast. In the 1820s Soshangane established the Gaza kingdom in the wider Limpopo country. His residence stood in the lower valley from 1827 to 1834, during a period when the movement of armies and communities was reshaping power across southeastern Africa.
simp_chinese: 林波波河下游在注入印度洋之前展开一片宽阔的洪泛平原。沙丘高出低洼的土地，河流与海洋共同塑造着近岸水道。19世纪20年代，索尚加内在更广阔的林波波地区建立加扎王国。1827年至1834年，他的驻地位于河流下游；这一时期，军队与社群的移动正在重塑非洲东南部的权力格局。

english: The lakes of the southern Chilean Andes lie in glacial basins amid wooded hills and volcanic peaks. In the country around Panguipulli and Riñihue, waterways link several lakes before the San Pedro River carries their waters westwards. Forests cover the intervening slopes, and mountain streams feed the lake system. Mapuche communities have long inhabited these valleys, whose lakes and rivers connect the foothills to lands nearer the Pacific.
simp_chinese: 智利南部安第斯湖泊坐落在冰川形成的盆地中，周围是林木丘陵和火山峰。潘吉普伊与里尼韦一带的水道连接数个湖泊，圣佩德罗河再将湖水带向西方。森林覆盖其间山坡，山间溪流汇入湖系。马普切社群长期居住在这些河谷，湖泊和河流将山麓与更靠近太平洋的土地相连。

sources.title: Guía paleobotanica del río San Pedro.pdf

english: The Xakriabá are an Indigenous people of the São Francisco valley in northern Minas Gerais, related in language and culture to the Xerente and other central Jê peoples. Their homeland lies near the river and its tributaries, in a region of dry woodland and grassland. Colonial cattle raising brought outsiders into this territory, a history remembered in Xakriabá accounts of encounters with ranchers and missionaries.
simp_chinese: 沙克里亚巴人是米纳斯吉拉斯北部圣弗朗西斯科河谷的原住民族，在语言和文化上与谢伦特人等中部热语族群有亲缘关系。他们的家园靠近圣弗朗西斯科河及其支流，位于干燥林地与草地交错的地区。殖民时期的牧牛业将外来者带入这片土地，沙克里亚巴人关于牧场主和传教士的叙述保存着双方相遇的记忆。

english: Xalacinco, later called Jalacingo, lies in the highlands near the descent from Puebla toward the Gulf coast. Its cool, humid country stands along a route between the central plateau and Veracruz. In August 1519 Hernán Cortés passed through Xalacingo on his march inland and sent messengers to neighbouring districts for provisions. The expedition continued through the mountain country toward the cities of the central highlands.
simp_chinese: 沙拉辛科后来称为哈拉辛戈，位于普埃布拉高地向墨西哥湾岸下降的地带。这里气候凉爽湿润，坐落在中部高原与韦拉克鲁斯之间的道路上。1519年8月，埃尔南·科尔特斯向内陆进军时经过沙拉辛科，并派使者向邻近地区索取补给。远征队随后穿过山区，前往中部高地的城市。

english:
Xalapa lies on the humid eastern slopes of the Mexican highlands, between the plateau and the port of Veracruz. Springs descend from the hills, and the town grew from Indigenous neighbourhoods inhabited by Nahua and Totonac communities. Its position on the road between Mexico City and the Gulf made it an important place for travellers and commerce.

After the Spanish conquest Xalapa remained an Indigenous town and became a regional administrative and religious centre. Mule trains, inns and warehouses served traffic between Veracruz and the interior. In the eighteenth century a great fair brought merchants together when fleets arrived from Spain. The trade transformed the town, encouraging the construction of houses and storehouses as goods changed hands before travelling onward to the highlands.
simp_chinese:
沙拉帕位于墨西哥高地东部湿润的山坡上，介于高原与韦拉克鲁斯港之间。泉水从山中流下，城镇由纳瓦和托托纳克社群居住的原住民街区发展而来。它位于墨西哥城与墨西哥湾之间的道路上，是旅人和商业的重要驻地。

西班牙征服后，沙拉帕仍是原住民城镇，并成为地区行政和宗教中心。骡队、旅店与仓库服务于韦拉克鲁斯和内陆之间的交通。十八世纪，西班牙船队到达时，盛大的集市将商人聚集起来。货物在继续运往高地前在此转手，贸易推动住宅与仓库建设，改变了城镇面貌。

english: Xalapan lies in the northern Nicaraguan highlands of the Matagalpa country, where wooded ridges and valleys shape travel and settlement. The name is Nahuatl in origin and is also borne by Jalapa in Nueva Segovia, a highland town. Matagalpa communities lived across these uplands under their own leaders, with traditions distinct from those of the Pacific lowlands. After the Spanish conquest, demands for tribute and labour reached the highland villages, which kept their own ties with neighbouring settlements.
simp_chinese: 沙拉潘位于尼加拉瓜北部高地的马塔加尔帕地区，林木覆盖的山脊与谷地影响交通与聚落分布。这个名称源自纳瓦特尔语，新塞哥维亚的哈拉帕也使用同一名称。马塔加尔帕社群在高地上由各自的首领领导，传统与太平洋低地的居民不同。西班牙征服之后，贡赋与劳役的要求传到了高地村落，村落仍保持着与邻近聚落之间的联系。

english: Xalima lies east of the Kolyma, near the northern Yukaghir Highlands. The Kolyma flows north through northeastern Siberia to the East Siberian Sea, receiving the Berezovka and Omolon from the east. In the highlands, sparse larch woods cover lower slopes and tundra occupies the heights.
simp_chinese: 哈利马位于科雷马河以东、尤卡吉尔高地北部附近。科雷马河穿过西伯利亚东北部向北流入东西伯利亚海，东面汇来别廖佐夫卡河与奥莫隆河。高地低坡生长着稀疏落叶松林，高处则为苔原。

english:
Xalisco was the centre of a lordship near the valley of Matatipac in western Mexico. The surrounding country preserves evidence of earlier inhabitants, including shaft tombs and carved rocks. In 1530 the expedition of Nuño de Guzmán reached the area after crossing the Santiago country. Its inhabitants resisted the invaders, but the town was taken and burned as the Spanish pushed toward the Pacific coast.

The later city of Tepic lies here.
simp_chinese:
哈利斯科是西墨西哥马塔蒂帕克谷地附近一个领地的中心。周围地区留有早期居民的遗迹，包括竖井墓和石刻。1530年，努尼奥·德·古斯曼的远征队穿过圣地亚哥河地区后抵达此地。居民抵抗入侵者，但在西班牙人向太平洋海岸推进的过程中，城镇被攻占并焚毁。

后来的特皮克即位于此地。

english:
Xalostotitlan, later Jalostotitlán, was a lordship in the highlands of western Mexico. Its inhabitants included Tecuexe and Caxcan people, and neighbouring settlements such as Teocaltitán and Temacapulín were subject to its rulers. The mountains and valleys of Los Altos became a contested frontier after Spanish forces entered the region.

During the Mixtón War, people of the region sought refuge on a hill now called San Miguel. After the war survivors returned from the hill to repopulate their former communities. A local account credits the Franciscan Miguel de Bolonia with refounding Jalostotitlán in 1544; Franciscans also repopulated nearby Mezquititlán with indigenous families from San Gaspar. By 1583 the rebuilt town was divided into four distinct barrios, La Cruz, San Andrés, San Nicolás and Santa Rosa.
simp_chinese:
沙洛斯托蒂特兰后来称为哈洛斯托蒂特兰，曾是西墨西哥高地的一个领地。居民包括特奎克塞人和卡斯坎人，特奥卡尔蒂坦、特马卡普林等邻近聚落受其领主管辖。西班牙军队进入后，洛斯阿尔托斯的山谷成为争夺中的边疆。

米斯顿战争期间，当地人到后来称为圣米格尔的山丘避难。战争结束后，幸存者从山上返回，重建原先的社区。地方记载称方济各会修士米格尔·德·博洛尼亚于1544年重建哈洛斯托蒂特兰；方济各会士还将来自圣加斯帕尔的原住民迁至附近的梅斯基蒂特兰。到1583年，重建的城镇已分为拉克鲁斯、圣安德烈斯、圣尼古拉斯和圣罗萨四个街区。

english:
Xaltocan was an Otomí city-state on an island in the lake of the same name, north of Lake Texcoco. Its position among the shallow lakes of the Basin of Mexico gave it access to a network of waterways and neighbouring settlements. For a time it was a major power in the northern basin, competing with other city-states for land and influence.

In the late fourteenth century Xaltocan fought a long struggle against Cuauhtitlan and its allies. Around 1395 an alliance including the Tepanecs of Azcapotzalco and the Mexica defeated the Otomí city. Many of its inhabitants left the island for other communities, including Otumba and Tlaxcala. The conquest marked a shift in power within the basin as Azcapotzalco and its allies expanded their influence.
simp_chinese:
沙尔托坎是一座奥托米人城邦，坐落在特斯科科湖以北的同名湖中岛上。它位于墨西哥盆地浅湖群之间，可以通过水道与邻近聚落相连。这里一度是盆地北部的重要强权，与其他城邦争夺土地和影响力。

十四世纪后期，沙尔托坎与夸乌蒂特兰及其盟友展开长期争斗。约1395年，包括阿斯卡波察尔科特帕内克人和墨西加人在内的联盟击败了这座奥托米城邦。许多居民离开岛屿，迁往奥通巴、特拉斯卡拉等地。这次征服标志着盆地内力量的转移，阿斯卡波察尔科及其盟友的势力随之扩大。

english: The ǀXam were San people of the dry Karoo country south of the Kalahari. Their language, with its distinctive click sounds, belonged to the Tuu family. Rock paintings, engravings and stone tools record the long presence of San communities across the interior. During the later eighteenth century, settler stock farmers pushed into the Karoo, and fighting over land and livestock grew fierce. Armed colonial commandos attacked San communities, killing inhabitants and taking captives as the frontier expanded.
simp_chinese: 卡姆是卡拉哈里以南干旱卡鲁地区的桑人。他们的语言属于图语系，具有鲜明的搭嘴音。岩画、岩刻和石器记录了桑人社群在这片内陆的长期存在。十八世纪后期，殖民牧场主进入卡鲁，土地和牲畜争夺演变为激烈冲突。随着边疆扩张，殖民武装队伍袭击桑人社群，杀害居民并掳走俘虏。

english: ǀXam was a San language of the Karoo, spoken across the dry interior north of the Cape. Its speakers hunted game and gathered wild foods among plains and rocky hills; their history is also reflected in the region's paintings, engravings and stone tools. In the eighteenth century colonial stock farmers moved onto the escarpment and into ǀXam country. The ensuing struggle over land and livestock brought raids, retaliatory expeditions and the loss of many lives.
simp_chinese: 卡姆语是开普以北卡鲁干旱内陆的一门桑人语言。使用者在平原与岩丘之间狩猎野兽、采集野生食物；当地的岩画、岩刻和石器也反映出他们的历史。十八世纪，殖民牧场主进入高地边缘和卡姆人的土地。随之而来的土地和牲畜争夺带来袭击、报复性远征与众多生命的损失。

english: Xam Neua lies in the mountainous Houaphanh country of northeastern Laos. Its name means “northern swamp”, recalling the wet ground of the valley among the steep surrounding hills. Houaphanh stood between the Lao and Vietnamese worlds, with numerous local communities in its river valleys and uplands. In the eighteenth century the Phuan ruler Chao Ong Lo withdrew to this country after defeat by Vientiane and began to assemble another army there.
simp_chinese: 桑怒位于老挝东北部多山的华潘地区。其名称意为“北方沼泽”，令人想起周围陡峭山岭之间谷地的湿润土地。华潘处在老挝与越南世界之间，河谷和高地上分布着许多地方社群。十八世纪，普安统治者昭翁罗被万象击败后退入这一地区，在此重新集结军队。

english:
Xamapan takes its name from the Jamapa River, which descends from the heights of Citlaltépetl to the Gulf of Mexico. Its Nahuatl name has been interpreted as “in the river of the adobes.” During the 1518 expedition along the coast, the Spaniards called its mouth the River of Banners after seeing people on shore holding white cotton banners. The river crosses the coastal plain before entering the sea at Boca del Río.

The later city of Veracruz lies here.
simp_chinese:
沙马潘得名于哈马帕河。这条河从锡特拉尔特佩特尔高处流向墨西哥湾，其纳瓦特尔语名称被解释为“土坯之河”。1518年沿海远航的西班牙人见到岸上有人举着白色棉布旗，便将河口称为“旗帜河”。河水穿过海岸平原，最终在博卡德尔里奥入海。

后来的韦拉克鲁斯即位于此地。

english: Between the Lower Tunguska and the Chona, the Central Siberian Plateau is a country of forested ridges and river valleys. The Lower Tunguska flows north and west to the Yenisei, while the Chona belongs to the Vilyuy and Lena basin. Coniferous taiga covers much of the upland, and the rivers remain frozen through the long winter. Their spring floods bring great changes to the water level.
simp_chinese: 下通古斯卡河与乔纳河之间的中西伯利亚高原，由森林覆盖的山脊和河谷构成。下通古斯卡河向北再向西流入叶尼塞河，乔纳河则属于维柳伊河与勒拿河水系。针叶泰加林覆盖着大片高地，河流在漫长冬季结冰，春季洪水则使水位大幅变化。

english: The forested hills of the Central Siberian Plateau separate the headwaters of rivers flowing towards the Lena and the Yenisei. The Chona crosses this upland on its way to the Vilyuy, while the Lower Tunguska carries its waters west to the Yenisei. Taiga covers the ridges and valleys, and a long season of ice gives way to a short summer. Lakes and streams lie among the forests of this northern interior.
simp_chinese: 中西伯利亚高原的森林丘陵分隔着流向勒拿河和叶尼塞河的河流源头。乔纳河穿越高地流向维柳伊河，下通古斯卡河则向西流入叶尼塞河。泰加林覆盖山脊与河谷，漫长冰封季节过后迎来短暂夏天。湖泊和溪流散布在这片北方内陆的森林之间。

english:
Xánthia lies where the wooded slopes of the Rhodope Mountains descend towards the Thracian plain. The Byzantine town was an episcopal centre and a fortified place involved in the struggles of medieval Thrace. Under Ottoman rule settlement gradually moved down from the old hilltop site, while trade and the cultivation of tobacco brought prosperity to the surrounding district.

Ottoman forces took the town in the late fourteenth century. In 1829 a series of strong earthquakes caused great destruction, but rebuilding soon began. Under Metropolitan Eugenios, churches were raised again in the Christian quarters, including those of the Archangels in 1834 and Saint George in 1835. Merchants also built houses and warehouses as the tobacco trade expanded, giving the recovering town a new appearance.
simp_chinese:
克桑西坐落在罗多彼山林木覆盖的山坡与色雷斯平原交接之处。拜占庭时期，这里是一处主教驻地和设防城镇，卷入中世纪色雷斯的种种争斗。奥斯曼统治期间，居民逐渐从旧山城迁往山脚，而贸易和烟草种植为周围地区带来繁荣。

十四世纪末，奥斯曼军队攻占城镇。1829年，一连串地震造成严重破坏，但重建很快开始。在都主教埃夫耶尼奥斯主持下，基督徒街区重建了教堂，包括1834年的大天使教堂和1835年的圣乔治教堂。随着烟草贸易发展，商人也兴建宅邸与仓库，逐渐恢复的城镇因而呈现新的面貌。

english: Xârâcùù is a Kanak language of southeastern Grande Terre, associated with the valleys and coast around Canala and Thio. The central mountains divide this country from the western coast, while rivers descend towards the lagoon and barrier reef. Clan lands and customary relationships linked its communities to their neighbours in the south and centre of New Caledonia.
simp_chinese: 哈拉库语是新喀里多尼亚大岛东南部的卡纳克语言，与卡纳拉和蒂奥一带的河谷及海岸相关。中央山脉将这一地区与西岸隔开，河流则流向潟湖与堡礁。氏族土地和习惯关系将当地社群与新喀里多尼亚中南部的邻居联系起来。

english: Xatśūll, “where the bubbling water comes out on the cliff,” is a Secwépemc place on the Fraser River. Sockeye and Chinook salmon travel upstream through these waters, supplying food to the people of the northern interior. Dried salmon, baskets, skins, and other goods also passed through networks of exchange with neighboring nations. In 1808 the trader Simon Fraser journeyed through Xatśūll country.
simp_chinese: 哈特苏尔意为“水从崖上冒出的地方”，是弗雷泽河畔一处塞克韦佩姆克人的地点。红鲑和帝王鲑沿河溯流而上，为北方内陆居民提供食物。鲑鱼干、篮具、兽皮等物品也通过交换网络流向邻近民族。1808年，商人西蒙·弗雷泽经过哈特苏尔人的土地。

english: Xatıŋnaax lies south of the Ozhogina and west of the Yukaghir Highlands. The Ozhogina valley, covered in sparse larch taiga, freezes in October and breaks up in May; farther east, larch on the lower slopes of the highlands gives way to mountain tundra.
simp_chinese: 哈廷纳赫位于奥若吉纳河以南、尤卡吉尔高地以西。奥若吉纳河谷覆有稀疏的落叶松林，河流在十月封冻、五月解冻；更东面的高地低坡也生长着落叶松，再往上则是山地苔原。

english:
Xavante belongs to central Brazil's cerrado, where wooded savannas, rivers and seasonal rain provide varied resources. Communities combine cultivation, hunting, gathering and fishing according to place and season. Paths connect resource areas, while knowledge of plants, animals and water supports travel. Social relationships and responsibilities also shape the use of land.

The Xavante are part of the Jê-speaking Indigenous history of Brazil's interior. Their communities maintained institutions of ceremony and exchange before colonial authorities sought more direct control. Eighteenth-century mining expansion increased pressure on inland routes, labour and land. Settlers, missionaries and officials brought demands that could lead to conflict and displacement; Indigenous communities responded through resistance, negotiation and movement.
simp_chinese:
沙万特属于巴西中部塞拉多地区，林木草原、河流和季节性降雨提供多样资源。居民根据地点和季节结合耕作、狩猎、采集与捕鱼。小路连接不同资源地，对植物、动物和水源的了解支持出行；社会关系和责任也影响土地使用。

沙万特人属于巴西内陆使用热语族语言的原住民。殖民当局试图直接控制之前，他们已维持仪式和交换等社群制度。十八世纪中部巴西矿业扩张增加了对内陆道路、劳力和土地的压力。定居者、传教士及官员的要求可能带来冲突与迁离，原住民则通过抵抗、协商和迁移应对。

english: Xazl Iimt is the Seri name for Ángel de la Guarda, a long, mountainous island in the northern Gulf of California. It lies off the Baja California Peninsula, separated from it by the Canal de las Ballenas. The Seri name has been translated as “where the pumas live,” and reflects the reach of a coastal people whose knowledge extended across the gulf. Archaeological remains on the island show that its plants and animals were used by Indigenous visitors over a long period.
simp_chinese: 沙兹利姆特是守护天使岛的塞里语名称。这座狭长多山的岛屿位于加利福尼亚湾北部，鲸鱼海峡将它与下加利福尼亚半岛分开。塞里语名称被译作“美洲狮居住的地方”，反映出这个沿海民族对海湾彼岸的认识。岛上的考古遗存显示，原住民访客在漫长时期内利用过岛上的植物和动物资源。

english: Xcalak lies at the southern end of the Caribbean coast of the Yucatán peninsula. Its narrow peninsula shelters the northern arm of Chetumal Bay from the open sea, while reefs lie offshore. Behind the coast, brackish wetlands and channels link the bay with neighbouring lagoons. Maya communities lived around Chetumal Bay and used the waterways connecting its shores with the wider Caribbean.
simp_chinese: 什卡拉克位于尤卡坦半岛加勒比海岸南端。狭窄的半岛为切图马尔湾北部遮挡外海，近海则分布着珊瑚礁。海岸后方的半咸水湿地与水道将海湾和邻近潟湖连接起来。玛雅社群曾生活在切图马尔湾周围，利用水路将沿岸与更广阔的加勒比海联系起来。

english:
Xelahuh, later known as Quetzaltenango, lies in a high valley surrounded by the volcanic mountains of western Guatemala. It was an important K’iche’ Maya center before the Spanish conquest. Its highland location placed it among highland communities connected to the larger K’iche’ political world, whose principal royal centers lay farther northeast.

In 1524 Pedro de Alvarado’s Spanish and Indigenous forces advanced into K’iche’ territory. Warriors resisted them in the Quetzaltenango valley before the invaders continued their march toward the K’iche’ capital. The settlement was subsequently drawn into colonial rule and came to be known by the Nahuatl name Quetzaltenango. Its K’iche’ name endured alongside the new one, preserving a connection to the city’s earlier inhabitants and the highland landscape around it.
simp_chinese:
谢拉胡后来被称为克萨尔特南戈，坐落在危地马拉西部火山群环抱的高谷中。西班牙征服以前，它是重要的基切玛雅中心，与更广大基切政治世界的诸社区相联系；主要王权中心位于更远的东北方。

1524年，佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多率领西班牙军队和原住民盟友进入基切领地。基切战士在克萨尔特南戈谷地抵抗入侵者，后者随后继续向基切都城推进。聚落此后被纳入殖民统治，并以纳瓦特尔语名字克萨尔特南戈闻名。基切名称与新名称并存，保存了城市同早期居民及周围高地景观的联系。

english: The Xerente, who call themselves Akwẽ, are a Jê-speaking people of the Tocantins valley. Their villages lie in the cerrado east of the river, amid grassland, woodland and streams. They are related in language and culture to the Xavante and Xakriabá. Colonial expansion and the effort to secure navigation on the rivers brought military posts and increasing pressure on the Indigenous communities of the region.
simp_chinese: 谢伦特人自称阿克韦，是托坎廷斯河谷操热语族语言的民族。他们的村落位于河东侧的塞拉多，周围有草地、林地和溪流。他们在语言和文化上与沙万特人、沙克里亚巴人有亲缘关系。殖民扩张和确保河上航行的行动带来了军事哨所，也使当地原住民社区面临越来越大的压力。

english: Xiabancheng stands on the eastern bank of the Luan River, where waterways meet among the hills. It was a river landing, and its name is associated with the stacks of timber once gathered at the wharf. During the Qing, the settlement grew alongside the imperial summer residence at nearby Chengde. Distilleries became established here, producing a spirit known as Bancheng shao for the surrounding countryside and markets farther afield.
simp_chinese: 下板城坐落在滦河东岸，山间河流在附近汇合。这里曾是水运码头，地名与码头堆放的木板有关。清代附近承德避暑山庄兴建后，聚落随之发展；当地烧锅作坊酿制的板城烧，供应周围乡村及更远的市场。

english: Xiàcài lies near the Huái River north of Shòuzhōu. Historical accounts associate the old settlement with the ancient state of Cài, whose remains were remembered in this region. Under the Míng, a patrol office at Xiàcài guarded a place within the jurisdiction of Shòuzhōu, beside the routes along the river.
simp_chinese: 下蔡位于寿州以北、淮河附近。古籍将这里的旧城与蔡国联系起来，蔡国遗迹在这一带为后人所记。明代寿州设有下蔡巡检司，在沿河道路附近管辖地方。

english: Xiajiang lies in the mountain country of southeastern Guizhou, along the river route from Guzhou toward Guangxi. The Duliu River winds between wooded slopes, carrying the waters of several tributaries southward. In 1732 the Qing moved an official from the Tanxi native office to Xiajiang. Later, in 1771, it stationed a prefectural officer here and established Xiajiang Subprefecture, giving the river settlement a new administrative role among the villages of the surrounding hills.
simp_chinese: 下江位于黔东南山地，是古州通往广西的河路所经之地。都柳江在林坡之间蜿蜒，汇集支流向南流去。1732年，清朝将潭溪土司的一名官员移驻下江；1771年又派府通判驻此，设下江厅，使这处河边聚落成为周围山寨的行政中心。

english: Xiajin lies on the plain of northwestern Shandong, among the traces of former Yellow River channels. Repeated shifts of the river left sandy ground where mulberry groves took root. The county had a long tradition of growing the trees, and by the middle Qing period their numbers had greatly increased; a local gazetteer described branches so close together that one could move from tree to tree for many li. The county's earliest recorded gazetteer was compiled in 1540 under the magistrate Yi Shizhong.
simp_chinese: 夏津位于山东西北平原，境内留有黄河故道的痕迹。黄河屡次改道，留下沙地，也孕育出桑树林。当地种桑历史悠久，清代中期桑树大增，县志称其枝条相连，可以攀援而行二十余里。夏津最早有记载的县志由知县易时中主持，于1540年编修。

english: Xiakou was a fortified place in the mountain country north of Wugang. Ten stockades were set up in the Song to guard the district, and Xiakou was one of them. During the Ming, officials maintained a patrol post here to control approaches through the hills, including routes used by Yao communities. The post administered numerous settlements and mountain places, their names survive in a list of the villages subject to Xiakou.
simp_chinese: 峡口是武冈北面山地中的一处要隘。宋代武冈军设十寨守卫辖区，峡口为其中之一。明代在此设巡检司，控制穿越山地的道路，包括瑶人出入的通道。巡司辖有众多村落和山间地方，其名称保存在一份辖地名录中。

english: Xiamen’s harbour lies among the islands of the southern Fujian coast. In the seventeenth century its sheltered waters became a base for the maritime power of Zheng Chenggong, known in the West as Koxinga. From Xiamen and nearby Jinmen, his organization traded across East Asia and fought the Qing after the fall of the Ming. His forces later shifted their base to Taiwan.
simp_chinese: 厦门港位于闽南海岸的岛屿之间。十七世纪，受庇护的港湾成为郑成功海上势力的据点。明朝灭亡后，他的集团以厦门和附近的金门为基地，在东亚各地贸易并与清朝作战，后来又将基地转移至台湾。

english: Xi'an is the county seat of Quzhou in western Zhejiang. It became home to the southern branch of the Kong family after descendants of Confucius followed the Song court south in the twelfth century. Their family temple preserved the rites of their ancestors far from Qufu. After Zhu Yuanzhang took Quzhou in 1359, he ordered repairs to the temple. In 1506 the Ming court granted Kong Yansheng a hereditary office to preside over the sacrifices. A new family temple was built on the former site of the county school in 1520–1521, with a residence for the family beside it.
simp_chinese: 西安是浙江西部衢州的附郭县。十二世纪，孔子后裔随宋廷南迁，在衢州定居，形成孔氏南宗。家族在远离曲阜的地方设立家庙，延续祭祀祖先的礼仪。1359年朱元璋攻取衢州后，命人修葺孔氏家庙。1506年，明廷授孔彦绳世袭官职，主持祭祀。1520至1521年，家庙迁建于西安县学旧址，旁边又建起孔府。

english:
Xiangcheng lies on the plain of eastern Henan, in the country of the Sha and Ying rivers, in the old Chenzhou. The Western Zhou had enfeoffed the Xiang state here, and the county of Xiang carried the name down the centuries; the Sui gave it the name Xiangcheng. Through the Song and Yuan its seat stood at Huaidian, on the river bank in what is now Shenqiu.

The Yellow River turned the place into a disaster zone in the early Ming. A flood in 1398 destroyed the county town at Huaidian, the Sha-Ying embankment broke again in 1408, and in 1428 the river rose once more and the walls of the town were submerged from Chen to Xiang. The government then moved the county seat west to Tankou, the old town of Xiangcheng, and the name of Xiangcheng disappeared from the ground around Huaidian.
simp_chinese:
项城位于河南东部平原，沙河与颍河流经此地，旧属陈州。西周曾在此封项国，后来的项县一直沿用此名，隋代定名为项城。宋元时期，县治在槐店，即今沈丘一带的河岸上。

明初，黄河让这里屡遭水患。洪武三十一年（1398年）洪水冲毁槐店县治，永乐六年（1408年）沙颍河再度决堤，宣德三年（1428年）黄河又一次泛滥，陈州到项城一带城郭尽被水淹。朝廷于是把县治向西迁到殄寇镇，也就是项城的老城，槐店一带从此不再有项城县之名。

english: Xiangcheng stands on the central Henan plain southwest of Xuzhou. Its Confucian temple joined the county school and a place of ritual in one complex, where officials and students honoured the sage. The main Dacheng Hall was rebuilt during the Zhengtong reign of the Ming on the foundations of an earlier Yuan building. In 1585 a decorated screen wall was added in front of the temple, its glazed surface and carved dragons giving the entrance a distinctive appearance.
simp_chinese: 襄城位于许州西南的河南平原。城中文庙兼为儒学和祭祀之所，官员与生徒在这里礼敬孔子。明正统年间，工匠在元代建筑的基础上重建大成殿。1585年，庙前又建起一座装饰华丽的影壁，琉璃与龙纹雕饰使入口更为庄严醒目。

english: Xianghe lies east of Beijing on the North Canal, the final stretch of the Grand Canal towards Tongzhou. Barges carried grain and building materials through its low-lying countryside. When the water ran low in 1533, the Ming ordered a new channel dug near Guoxinzhuang to draw water from the Chaobai River. One late Ming vessel carrying bricks for the capital sank along the canal here.
simp_chinese: 香河位于北京以东的北运河沿岸，运河向北通往通州。漕船经过低平的乡间，运送粮食和建筑材料。1533年河水枯竭，明廷下令在郭辛庄附近开挖新河，引潮白河水入运河。晚明一艘为京城运砖的船只曾在香河段沉没。

english: Xiangning lies in the mountains of southwestern Shanxi, west of the Fen River valley. South of the county town rises Yunqiu Mountain, where villages nestle among wooded slopes and ravines. At Ta'erpo, inhabitants built cave dwellings and courtyards from local stone, fitting their houses to the hillside; stone lanes and steps connect the different levels. Old locust and persimmon trees stand among the settlements, while mountain temples preserve traditions of Daoist worship.
simp_chinese: 乡宁位于山西西南部群山之中，汾河谷地以西。县城南面的云丘山林木葱茏，村落散布于山坡沟谷间。塔尔坡的居民就地取石，依山势修筑窑洞和院落，以石巷、石阶连接高低不同的房屋。村中有古槐、柿树，山间庙宇则保存着道教祭祀的传统。

english: Xiangru lay beside the Jialing River in the hills of the Sichuan Basin. The old county became the seat of Pengzhou under the Yuan, after the prefecture moved from its earlier seat. Its territory also absorbed land from the former Pengchi County. Early in the Ming, Xiangru County was abolished and its land placed directly under Pengzhou, which belonged to Shunqing Prefecture. The old town remained a local centre on the river, its changing administrative names preserving the history of the districts brought together around it.
simp_chinese: 相如位于四川盆地的丘陵间，靠近嘉陵江。元代蓬州迁治相如，这座旧县城因此成为州治；原蓬池县的一部分土地也并入相如。明初废相如县，其地直属蓬州，蓬州则隶属顺庆府。河畔旧城仍是地方中心，历次更改的行政名称留下了周边地区合并、调整的痕迹。

english: At the mouth of the Yong River, Zhāobǎo Mountain guards the approach to Níngbō. Its position made it an important part of the coastal defences of Zhènhǎi. In 1560, during the Ming dynasty, the commander Lu Tang built the Wēiyuǎn fortress on the mountain and placed four cannon there, strengthening the position against attacks from the sea.
simp_chinese: 甬江入海口的招宝山扼守通往宁波的水路，是镇海海防的重要据点。明代1560年，将领卢镗在山上筑威远城，安置四门火炮，加强了这里抵御海上袭击的防御。

english: Xiangshan lies on the western side of the Pearl River estuary, with waterways leading north to Guangzhou and south towards the sea. Its historical county included the port of Macau, where Chinese and foreign merchants met at the edge of the delta. Portuguese traders settled at Macau in the middle of the sixteenth century, establishing a port connected to Japan, Southeast Asia and India. Chinese officials administered the area through Xiangshan and supervised maritime defence and trade. In 1679, after restrictions on coastal trade, the Qing permitted overland commerce between the mainland and Macau through the border gate.
simp_chinese: 香山位于珠江口西岸，水路北通广州，南达大海。旧香山县辖有澳门，海内外商人在三角洲边缘的港口相聚。 十六世纪中叶，葡萄牙商人在澳门定居，港口逐渐发展出通往日本、东南亚和印度的贸易联系。中国官员经香山县管理当地事务，并监督海防与贸易。经历海禁后，清廷于1679年准许内地与澳门经关闸进行陆路贸易。

english:
Xiangtan grew beside a deep stretch of the Xiang River, its waterfront providing a sheltered place for boats. Rice from the surrounding country and goods from farther afield made the town one of Hunan's great commercial centres. Its lotus seeds were prized as tribute, and its riverside streets stretched for miles beyond the old county walls.

From the later Ming, merchants gathered at Xiangtan to trade in grain and medicinal herbs. In 1644 a merchant from Jiangxi opened a medicine shop near the river; others from his home province followed. During the Qing, goods from southern and western China passed through the port toward Hankou and the lower Yangtze. Its merchants also connected the interior with Guangzhou, packing tea and silk for shipment south.
simp_chinese:
湘潭依湘江深潭而兴，江岸为舟船提供避风停泊之处。周边的稻米与远方货物在此汇集，使它成为湖南重要商埠。当地湘莲曾作为贡品，沿江街市也不断向县城之外延伸。

明代中后期起，粮食与药材商人云集湘潭。1644年，一位江西药商在江边开设药行，后来同乡相继前来。清代，西南与湘南货物经此转往汉口和长江下游；商人也把茶叶、丝绸在湘潭装箱，南运广州，连接内地与沿海市场。

english:
Xiangxiang lies in central Hunan, in the basin of the Lian River, a tributary of the Xiang. Its name has a long administrative history: the place was associated with a marquisate in the Western Han and later became a county.

Xiangxiang was raised to a prefecture under the Yuan in 1295, then returned to county status during the transition to Ming rule. Under the Ming and Qing it belonged to Changsha Prefecture.
simp_chinese:
湘乡位于湖南中部的涟水流域，涟水是湘江支流。其名称和建制历史悠久：西汉时已与湘乡侯国有关，后来又设为县。

元代1295年，湘乡升为州；元明交替期间又降为县。明清两代，湘乡属长沙府。

english:
Xiāngyáng stands on the southern bank of the Hàn River, facing Fánchéng across the water, and its walls guarded the road from the north China plain into the middle Yangtze. Its fame came from the Mongol siege of 1268–73, when the Sòng commander Lǚ Wénhuàn held out for nearly five years and surrendered only after Fánchéng had fallen.

In 1364 Zhū Yuánzhāng's government made the Yuán route a prefecture, and early in the Míng Dèng Yù rebuilt the walls on the old foundations, with six gates, the Hàn to the north and a moat cut on the other three sides. In 1436 the Prince of Xiāng, Zhū Zhānshàn, moved his fief here from Chángshā. Floods were a standing danger: in 1566 the Old Dragon Dike west of the city broke and the water swept along its southern side.

In 1641 Zhāng Xiànzhōng got into Xiāngyáng with captured army tallies and killed the prince, Zhū Yìmíng, and early in 1643 Lǐ Zìchéng occupied the city, renamed it Xiāngjīng and lived in the prince's palace. Under the Qīng, Xiāngyáng lived on the Hàn River trade, its wharves crowded with merchant boats. In 1796 Xiāngyáng men led by Yáo Zhīfù and Wáng Cōng'ér rose with the White Lotus sect, and the rebellion spread up the Hàn valley into Sichuan and Shaanxi.
simp_chinese:
襄阳位于汉江南岸，与樊城隔江相望，城墙扼守从华北平原进入长江中游的道路。它最为人知的是1268至1273年的蒙古围城：宋将吕文焕坚守近五年，樊城陷落后才献城投降。

1364年，朱元璋政权将元代的襄阳路改为襄阳府；明初，邓愈在旧城基上重筑城池，开六门，北临汉水，东、西、南三面凿有护城河。正统元年（1436年），襄王朱瞻墡自长沙移藩襄阳。水患是长久之忧：嘉靖四十五年（1566年），城西老龙堤决口，洪水直冲城南。

1641年，张献忠用缴获的军符骗开城门，杀死襄王朱翊铭；1643年初，李自成占据襄阳，改称襄京，修缮襄王宫殿居住。清代襄阳仰赖汉江商运，码头上商船相连。1796年，襄阳人姚之富与王聪儿随白莲教起事，战火沿汉江河谷蔓延到四川、陕西。

english: Xiangyi was an ancient county on the Sui River in eastern Henan. Its embroidered fabrics were renowned under the Han, when an office here supplied fine textiles for imperial ceremonies. The town later became the seat of Suizhou, named for the river, and Xiangyi County was absorbed into the prefecture under the Ming. West of the city rose a wooded ridge called Camel Hill, where a terrace was traditionally associated with Duke Xiang of Song. Higher ground behind the town offered refuge when floods came.
simp_chinese: 襄邑是豫东睢水边的古县。汉代这里以锦绣闻名，设有服官，为皇室礼仪供应织物。后来县城成为睢州治所，州名取自睢水；明代襄邑县并入州治。城西有林木繁茂的骆驼冈，冈上襄公台相传与宋襄公有关。州城后方的高地，则在水患来临时为居民提供避难之所。

english:
Xiangyin stands on the Xiang River near the southern reaches of Lake Dongting. Its county seat was moved to the riverside at Wasuitan in 1130, after several earlier changes of location. The county had originally been established in the fifth century to accommodate refugees from the Ba and Xia regions upstream.

Raised to a prefecture under the Yuan, Xiangyin became a county again in 1369 and belonged to Changsha Prefecture throughout the Ming and Qing. Its Confucian temple, founded in the Song, was repeatedly repaired. In 1747 the magistrate Xu Liangdong added a pool and bridge; further rebuilding followed in 1773 and 1825, with local gentry taking part in the latter work.
simp_chinese:
湘阴坐落在湘江之滨，靠近洞庭湖南部。此县始置于五世纪，原为安置巴、峡流民而设；县治几经迁移，于1130年移到湘江边的瓦碎潭。

元代湘阴升为州，1369年明朝将其降为县，明清两代均属长沙府。县城文庙始建于宋，后屡经修葺。1747年知县徐梁栋增修泮池与桥，1773年和1825年又有重修，后一次工程有地方士绅参与。

english:
Xiāngyuán was founded in 455 BC, when Zhao Xiangzi built a walled town north of the Gan River and named it Xiangyuan. It stands in the Zhuozhang River basin of southeastern Shanxi, in the hills on the plateau west of the Taihang range, and the county has kept the name for twenty-three centuries.

In the Ming and Qing the county belonged to the Lu'an administration centred on Changzhi. The county seat had a City God temple founded in 1370, with halls and a stage for performances. Villages along the river honoured Zhaozewang, a deity whose worship spread from around Xiangyuan; temples to him were founded or repaired repeatedly over the centuries, among them new village shrines in the Ming and at the beginning of the Qing.
simp_chinese:
襄垣始建于公元前455年，赵襄子在甘水之北筑起城邑，取名襄垣。它位于山西东南部的浊漳河盆地，在太行山以西的高原丘陵之间，县名沿用了两千三百多年，从未更改。

明清时期，襄垣属潞安一带的地方行政体系，中心在长治。县城的城隍庙始建于1370年，庙中有殿宇和戏台。沿河村落还祭祀昭泽王，这位神灵的信仰从襄垣一带向四周传播；历代乡民不断创建或修葺昭泽王庙，明代与明清之际都出现了新的村社祠庙，一直延续下来，成为河谷乡村共同的祭祀传统。

english: Xianju lies among the mountains of eastern Zhejiang, along the Yong'an River. Southwest of the county seat is Gaoqian, a village associated with the Wu lineage. Generations of the family produced officials and examination graduates, including the Ming official Wu Shilai. Its houses and halls stand on the plain beside the river, preserving the traces of a lineage whose fortunes were rooted in this mountain county.
simp_chinese: 仙居位于浙江东部山区，永安溪流经县境。县城西南的高迁村与吴氏家族关系密切，历代出了许多科举及第者和官员，其中有明代御史吴时来。村落的住宅与厅堂坐落在溪畔平地上，留下这一山地县份宗族生活的痕迹。

english: Xiankang was the seat of Chuanzhou under the Liao, in the country northeast of Chaoyang. When the Liao renamed Baichuanzhou as Chuanzhou in 951, Xiankang served as its administrative centre, and a military governor of Changning was appointed there. The settlement stood within a region of hills and river valleys between the northeastern plains and the grasslands, where Liao rulers organised prefectures and counties alongside their military commands.
simp_chinese: 咸康位于朝阳东北一带，辽代为川州治所。951年白川州改名川州，并设长宁军节度使，州治便在咸康。这片山岭与河谷交错的地区处于东北平原和草原之间，辽朝在此设州县，并配以军事统辖机构。

english:
Xianning lies in southern Hubei, in the wider country associated with Wuchang and the middle Yangtze. Its valleys and wooded hills formed part of a landscape of farming settlements and routes between neighbouring districts.

Yong'an town was established in 768 and raised to county status in 955; in 1007 the county was renamed Xianning. Under the Yuan it belonged to Wuchang Circuit, and in the Ming and Qing periods to Wuchang Prefecture.
simp_chinese:
咸宁位于湖北南部，属于与武昌及长江中游相联系的地区。河谷与林木丘陵之间分布着农业聚落，道路连接邻近县域。

768年设永安镇，955年升为永安县，1007年改名咸宁县。元代咸宁隶属武昌路，明清时期属武昌府。

english: Xianning was one of the two counties sharing the city of Xi'an, alongside Chang'an. Its name was adopted under the Jin in 1181 and remained in use through the Ming and Qing. The two county administrations served a city built upon the remains of the Tang capital, where streets converged on the great Bell Tower. The Ming built the tower in 1384. As the city expanded and its centre shifted east, the magistrates of Xianning and Chang'an were ordered to move it to its new position in 1582. Its bell announced the hours and gave warning to the inhabitants, while the two county offices continued to administer the city and its surrounding countryside.
simp_chinese: 咸宁是与长安共同管理西安城的两个附郭县之一。此名于金代1181年采用，明清沿用。两县共治的府城建立在唐都遗址之上，城中街道汇聚于钟楼。明朝于1384年修建钟楼。随着城池扩建、中心东移，咸宁与长安两县知县奉命于1582年将钟楼迁至新址。楼上大钟用于报时和警示，两个县衙则继续管理城内及周边乡村。

english:
Xiányáng lies on the Wei River plain near Xi'an, where fertile land and routes across Guanzhong supported settlement and exchange. Its Ming and Qing county seat stood on the north bank of the Wei, about fifteen kilometres west of the site of the ancient Qin capital. The landscape carried memories of imperial power, but the later town had its own history and institutions.

During the Ming and Qing centuries, the wider Guanzhong region remained important to administration, military supply, and commerce. County officials and community organizations managed taxation, landholding, and public obligations. Production could be threatened by drought, flood, or warfare, making recovery a practical and social task. Xiányáng's historical significance in this period is best understood through its role within a productive and strategically connected plain rather than by repeating only its ancient capital history. Its position illustrates how older prestige and useful geography could coexist, while ordinary farmers, transport workers, and merchants sustained the routes and supplies linking local society with the demands of a major regional center and a wider imperial economy.
simp_chinese:
咸阳位于西安附近渭河平原，沃土和穿越关中的路线支持定居及交换。明清咸阳县城位于渭河北岸，距秦咸阳故址约十五公里。这里承载古都的记忆，但后来的城镇拥有自身的历史和地方机构。

明清时期，广大关中仍对行政、军需供应和商业重要。县官及社区组织管理税收、土地和公共义务。干旱、洪水或战争可能威胁生产，使恢复成为实际及社会任务。这一时期咸阳意义适合从生产力较高、战略联系紧密平原中的作用理解，不宜只重复古都历史。位置体现古老声望与有用地理能够并存，普通农民、运输劳动者和商人则维持道路及供应，把地方社会同重要地区中心和更广帝国经济需求连接。水利管理、可靠交通和持续合作，是机构及市场运行不可缺少的条件，也影响家庭面对灾害与政治变化的处境。

english:
Xiānyóu belongs to the Xinghua country of central Fujian, where cultivated valleys and wooded hills connect inland communities with coastal routes. Rice farming supported households, while forests and local craft activity supplied additional products. Markets and paths brought people together from different environments. Rivers helped move goods, but transport through the hills still required labor, local knowledge, and dependable stopping places.

During the Ming and Qing, Xianyou was administered under Xinghua prefecture. In the wider Fujian region, lineage institutions, education, religion and commerce shaped local relationships. Family organizations helped manage property and community obligations, while examination success could link local elites with imperial service. Coastal trade influenced inland markets, though war and changes in maritime policy could disrupt exchange.
simp_chinese:
仙游属于福建中部兴化地区，耕作河谷和森林丘陵把内陆社区同沿海路线连接。稻作支持家庭，森林及地方工艺供应补充产品。市场和小径汇集不同环境的人群。河流帮助运货，山地运输仍需要劳动、地方知识与可靠停留点，居民生活也依靠持续维护生产和交通条件。

明清时期，仙游隶属兴化府。更广阔的福建地区，宗族、教育、宗教和商业塑造地方关系。家族组织帮助管理财产与社区义务，科举成就能够将地方精英同帝国仕途连接。沿海贸易影响内陆市场，而战争和海洋政策变化也可能打断交换。

english: Xi'anzhou was a frontier district in the dry hills north of the Liupan Mountains, around the routes between Guyuan and the Yellow River. Its territory included land around the upper Qing River, which rises near Kaicheng and flows north toward the great river. The Song established the Zhou in a region contested with Western Xia, where valleys and pastures supported both movement and settlement. Its name belongs to this northwestern borderland rather than to the distant city of Xi'an.
simp_chinese: 西安州是六盘山以北干燥丘陵中的边地，处在固原通往黄河的道路附近。其辖境包括清水河上游一带，河水发源于开成附近，向北注入黄河。宋朝在与西夏争夺的地区设州，河谷和牧地既供人居住，也为行旅提供通道。这里的州名属于西北边地，并非远处的西安城。

english: Xianzhu was a market district in the coastal country of historical Ninghai, within Taizhou. Song records list a commercial tax station and a salt-selling establishment here, alongside those of other towns in the prefecture. Later gazetteers described markets in the Xianzhu district, including places where goods were sold on particular days. These records show a network of small market settlements linked to the larger county and its coast.
simp_chinese: 县渚是台州旧宁海县境内的市镇地区。宋代记载中，这里设有商税务和售盐场，与府内其他城镇的税场并列。后来的府志列出县渚地区的多个集市，有些以特定日期开市，显示小市镇与县城、沿海之间存在往来。

english: Xiaodandang lies in the highlands north of Lijiang, among the mountain valleys leading toward Zhongdian. The district appears in accounts of the territory governed from Lijiang under local hereditary rulers. During the Ming the Mu family extended its influence over the neighboring mountains, including Zhongdian and the country farther west. Their domain included mines and salt wells, while paths over the ridges connected communities separated by steep river gorges.
simp_chinese: 小旦当位于丽江以北的高地，山谷通向中甸。地方史料将这一带列入丽江土官治理的地区。明代，木氏土司向邻近山地扩展势力，辖区包括中甸及更西方的地方。域内有矿山与盐井，翻越山岭的道路连接着被陡峭峡谷隔开的聚落。

english: Xiǎodǒng lies north of Qīnzhōu, inland from the northern coast of the Gulf of Tonkin. Its market was established during the Wanli reign of the Ming, when members of the Dǒng family founded a trading settlement here. The name Xiǎodǒng, or “Little Dong”, preserves that connection. The market grew among the communities of the Qīnzhōu countryside, providing a place where people from the surrounding districts could meet and exchange their produce.
simp_chinese: 小董位于钦州以北、北部湾海岸的内陆。明万历年间，董姓居民在此倡建圩市，地名“小董”便与他们有关。圩市在钦州乡村地区兴起，为周围村落的居民提供了聚集和交换物产的场所。

english: Xiàogǎn lies on the northern edge of the Jiānghàn plain, where the Fǔ and Huán rivers join south of the town. The county name goes back to the Southern dynasties. It was first Xiàochāng, “flourishing filial piety”, in 454 under the Liú Sòng, after three legendary filial sons; in 924, under the Later Táng, it was changed to Xiàogǎn after Dǒng Yǒng sold himself to bury his father, Huáng Xiāng fanned his father's pillow, and Mèng Zōng wept for bamboo shoots. Wars of the Sòng against the Jīn and the Mongols, and then the Red Turbans, emptied eastern Húběi, and under the early Míng newcomers made up about three fifths of its people, most of them from Jiāngxī, above all Ráozhōu, Nánchāng and Jiǔjiāng, so that the Huáng-Xiào country was almost refilled. From this region many families later moved on to Sìchuān.
simp_chinese: 孝感位于江汉平原北缘，府河、澴河在城南汇合。县名可追溯到南朝：宋孝建元年（454年）因民间相传此地有董永、黄香、孟宗三大孝子，设县名“孝昌”；后唐同光二年（924年）改称“孝感”，取董永卖身葬父、黄香扇枕温衾、孟宗哭竹生笋的故事。宋金、宋元战争和元末红巾军起义使鄂东人口锐减，明初洪武移民使外来者占当地人口约六成，其中以江西移民最多，尤以饶州、南昌、九江为主，黄孝一带的人口几乎重建。后来又有许多家族从这里迁往四川。

english: Xiaoshan lies south of the Qiantang River. Nearby Xiang Lake was made into a reservoir under the Song, when embankments between the hills retained water for fields below. In wet seasons it stored runoff; in dry weather it supplied irrigation. From the Ming onward, farmers and powerful local families disputed the use of the lake, as parts were enclosed for cultivation. In 1689, during a severe drought, members of the Sun family built an embankment across the dry lakebed. Local officials and residents opposed the work because it interfered with the reservoir on which surrounding communities relied.
simp_chinese: 萧山位于钱塘江南岸。附近的湘湖在宋代筑塘成库，利用山岭间的堤岸蓄水，雨季储存山水，旱时灌溉下游田地。 明代以后，湖田围垦引起居民与地方豪族之间的争执。1689年大旱时，孙氏族人在干涸的湖底筑堤；当地官员与居民认为此举妨碍蓄水，损害周围乡民的利益，因而加以反对。

english: Xiaoxi was the old seat county of Suining on the Fu River. It had previously been known as Fangyi, the name under which it served as the seat of Suizhou in the Tang; the Song renamed it Xiaoxi. Under the Yuan the neighbouring counties of Suining and Qingshi were incorporated into Xiaoxi, and the prefecture was reduced to a Zhou. The Ming abolished the seat county itself in the early years of the dynasty, before reducing Suining Zhou to a county. The old county's name nevertheless remained in local histories.
simp_chinese: 小溪是涪江边遂宁州的旧附郭县。唐代这里称方义，是遂州治所；宋代改名小溪。元代将邻近的遂宁、青石二县并入小溪，又将府降为州。明初省去州治小溪县，随后将遂宁州降为县。小溪的旧名仍留存在地方史志之中。

english: Xiāo County lies on the plains west of Xúzhōu, where the northern hills meet the agricultural country of the Huái basin. The area has a long tradition of painting: Hàn stone reliefs show an early flourishing of pictorial art, while during the Míng and Qīng a local school of painting associated with Lóngchéng became known across the Yellow and Huái river region.
simp_chinese: 萧县位于徐州以西，北方丘陵在此与淮河流域的农耕平原相接。这里绘画传统悠久，汉代画像石见证了早期绘画的兴盛；明清时期，龙城画派又闻名黄淮地区。

english: Xiaoyi is an old county on the western side of the Shanxi basin. Its name, meaning filial devotion and righteousness, is traditionally associated with Zheng Xing, whose care for his mother was praised under the Tang. In the village of Jiajiazhuang, the Temple of the Three Sovereigns honours ancient culture heroes including Fuxi, Shennong and the Yellow Emperor. Inscriptions record repairs and additions to the temple in 1742, 1793 and 1829.
simp_chinese: 孝义是山西盆地西侧的古县。县名相传与唐代郑兴孝母的故事有关，意为孝行与义举。县境贾家庄的三皇庙供奉伏羲、神农和黄帝等古代圣王，庙中碑刻记载了1742年、1793年和1829年的修葺、增建。

english:
Xiaozhen'an belongs to the southwestern Guangxi border country associated with Guishun, where limestone uplands and valleys connect southern China with neighboring lands. Cultivation occupies suitable ground, while forest resources, livestock, and local crafts diversify livelihoods. Routes through passes connect communities with different products and languages, making exchange important despite difficult terrain. Water availability and seasonal rainfall shape where fields and settlements can be maintained.

The wider region was inhabited by Zhuang and other communities whose hereditary leaders interacted with imperial institutions. Xiaozhen'an was a local chieftaincy in the area of present-day Napo. In 1765, during the Qing dynasty, its hereditary office was removed and replaced by appointed administration. Frontier markets and kinship relationships continued to connect communities across official boundaries, while mountain agriculture and local knowledge supported everyday life.
simp_chinese:
小镇安属于广西西南归顺相关边地，石灰岩高地谷地连接华南与邻国。适宜土地耕作，林产、牲畜和工艺补充生计，山口路线联系物产语言不同社区，地形困难仍使交换重要。水源降雨决定田村维持地点，实际生活需要跨谷资源和可靠合作，边地联系具有长期基础。

广大地区壮族等社区的世袭领袖同王朝制度互动。小镇安土司位于今那坡一带，清乾隆三十年（1765年）被革职改流，改由委派官员治理。边市和亲族关系继续跨越官方边界，山地农业及地方知识支撑居民日常生活。

english: Xiàpī was an ancient city on the plains east of Xúzhōu. At the end of the Hàn dynasty, Cáo Cāo diverted the Yí and Sì rivers against its walls, capturing the warlord Lǚ Bù after a siege. Centuries later, floods and sediment from the Yellow River buried the old city, whose walls lay beneath deep deposits.
simp_chinese: 下邳是徐州以东平原上的古城。东汉末年，曹操引沂水、泗水灌城，围困并擒获吕布。数百年后，黄河洪水和泥沙掩埋了这座旧城，城墙逐渐沉入深厚的沉积层之下。

english: Xiaxian in southern Shanxi was the ancestral home of the Song statesman and historian Sima Guang. After his death in 1086, he was buried in the family cemetery on Mingtiao Ridge. A memorial stele bore an inscription composed by Su Shi, and the nearby Yuqing Buddhist monastery was closely connected with the tomb. The grave remained a place of remembrance in later centuries; its stele was repaired during the Ming dynasty.
simp_chinese: 山西南部的夏县是宋代政治家、史学家司马光的故里。他于1086年去世后，葬在鸣条冈的家族墓地。墓前神道碑由苏轼撰文，附近的余庆禅院也与墓园关系密切。后世仍有人前来凭吊，明代还重修了墓碑。

sources.title: 25304 山西省夏县司马光墓余庆禅院的建筑.pdf

english: Xiayi lies on the eastern Henan plain, in the lands administered from Guide. The county was known as Xiayi, written with a character meaning 'below', under the Yuan; early in the Ming its name was written with a character meaning 'summer' instead. Its walls were enlarged during the Zhengtong reign and repaired under the Qing. Local officials first compiled a county gazetteer in 1547, recording the territory's waterways, customs, taxes, schools and notable people for later generations.
simp_chinese: 下邑位于河南东部平原，归德管辖的地区之内。元代县名作“下邑”，明初改写为“夏邑”。县城在正统年间增筑，清代又经修缮。嘉靖二十六年，地方官首次编修县志，记述境内山川、风俗、赋税、学校与人物，供后世查考。

english: Xībǎo was one of the hereditary native chiefships of the Ānshùn region in central Guizhou. Its establishment belonged to the reorganisation of local government following the early Ming conquest and the abolition of Pǔdìng Prefecture. Relations with the new dynasty could be turbulent: in 1393, the Xībǎo chief Ā Dé and leaders of other stockades rose against Ming authority. The court sent the Guizhou commander Gù Chéng to suppress them, an episode recorded in the Ming history of Ānshùn.
simp_chinese: 西堡是贵州中部安顺地区的世袭土司之一。明初征服西南并废除普定府后，朝廷重新安排地方建置，西堡长官司是其中之一。当地与新王朝的关系并非始终平静：洪武二十六年（1393年），西堡长官阿德与诸寨首领起事，明廷派贵州都指挥顾成率军平定。

english:
In the dry uplands of Chihuahua, the Sacramento and Chuvíscar rivers meet below the mountains of Santa Eulalia. Concho communities lived in the region before Spanish missions and mining camps transformed it. A Franciscan mission called Nombre de Dios was founded for the Conchos in 1697 near the site of the later town, on the northern frontier of Nueva Vizcaya.

Rich discoveries at Santa Eulalia in 1707 brought a rush of miners to the mountains. The steep terrain made expansion difficult, and in 1709 the governor Antonio de Deza y Ulloa chose the nearby valley at the meeting of the rivers for a new settlement. It grew into San Felipe el Real de Chihuahua, linking the mining district to the roads and farms of the surrounding country.
simp_chinese:
奇瓦瓦干燥的高地上，萨克拉门托河与丘维斯卡尔河在圣欧拉利亚山地脚下汇合。西班牙传教站和矿营改变这一地区之前，孔乔社群已在附近生活。1697年，方济各会为孔乔人建立诺姆布雷德迪奥斯传教站，地点靠近新比斯开北部边疆后来兴起的城镇。

1707年圣欧拉利亚发现丰富矿藏，矿工纷纷涌入山地。陡峭地形不利于扩张，1709年总督安东尼奥·德·德萨·伊·乌略亚选择附近两河交汇的谷地建立新聚落。这里后来发展为圣费利佩埃尔雷亚尔德奇瓦瓦，将矿区与周围地区的道路和农田连接起来。

english: Xicalango lay on the southern Gulf coast near Laguna de Términos, a meeting place of waterways connecting the Yucatán Peninsula with the lands to the west. Before the Spanish conquest it was an important trading region where Maya and other Mesoamerican merchants exchanged goods. Its coastal lagoons and river routes linked seaborne traffic with the interior, making the low shore a meeting point between distinct commercial networks.
simp_chinese: 希卡兰戈位于墨西哥湾南岸、特米诺斯潟湖附近，连接尤卡坦半岛与西方地区的水道在此交汇。西班牙征服之前，这里是重要的贸易地区，玛雅及其他中美洲商人在此交换货物。沿海潟湖与河流通道将海上交通和内陆连接起来，使低平海岸成为不同商业网络的交汇点。

english: Xicallanco was a trading centre near the Laguna de Términos on the southern shore of the Gulf of Mexico. Its position connected maritime routes around the Yucatán Peninsula with rivers leading inland toward Acalan. Maya merchants moved goods between coastal and interior communities, using canoes through a landscape of estuaries and lagoons. Along with Potonchan farther west, Xicallanco formed an important meeting point in the exchange networks of the Gulf coast.
simp_chinese: 希卡兰科是墨西哥湾南岸特尔米诺斯潟湖附近的贸易中心。它的位置将环绕尤卡坦半岛的海路与通往内陆阿卡兰的河流联系起来。玛雅商人乘独木舟穿过河口与潟湖，在沿海和内陆社群之间运送货物。希卡兰科与更西面的波通昌一起，构成墨西哥湾岸交换网络的重要交会点。

english: Xicaltepec lies in the country of Teotitlan and Tochtepec, between upland valleys and the warmer lowlands of eastern Mesoamerica. Hills and river corridors linked communities whose lands differed in climate and resources, and dyes were among the goods of the district. A town called Xicaltepec appears in the Tochtepec tribute list of the Codex Mendoza, a record of the obligations owed to the Mexica empire.
simp_chinese: 希卡尔特佩克位于特奥蒂特兰与托奇特佩克一带，介于美索美洲东部的高地河谷与较温暖的低地之间。山丘与河谷通道连接着气候和物产各异的社区，染料是这一带的物产之一。《门多萨抄本》的托奇特佩克贡赋名单中出现了一处名为希卡尔特佩克的城镇，该名单记录了墨西加帝国的贡赋义务。

english: Xicheng stands in the upper Han River valley, between the Qinling and the Daba Mountains. An ancient county seat, it became the centre of Jinzhou, whose name was associated with gold found in the Yue River valley. The Yuan absorbed Xicheng County into the prefecture. In 1583 the Ming renamed Jinzhou Xing'an; in 1782 the Qing raised Xing'an to a superior prefecture and established Ankang County at its seat. The old town remained the administrative centre of the river basin through these changes.
simp_chinese: 西城位于汉江上游河谷，地处秦岭与大巴山之间。古县治后来成为金州的中心，州名与越河流域出产的砂金有关。元代西城县并入州，明朝于1583年将金州改名兴安州。1782年，清朝升兴安州为府，并在府城设安康县；这座古城始终是汉江河谷的重要行政中心。
